title.en: Volume 369 Biographies 128: Zhang Jun, Zhang Zongyan, Liu Guangshi, Wang Yuan, Jie Yuan, Qu Duan
title.raw: 卷三百六十九 列傳第一百二十八 張俊 張宗顏 劉光世 王淵 解元 曲端 Volume 369 Biographies 128: Zhang Jun, Zhang Zongyan, Liu Guangshi, Wang Yuan, Jie Yuan, Qu Duan

sentences.zh: 張俊從子:子蓋 張宗顏 劉光世 王淵 解元 曲端

translations.literal: Zhang Jun's collateral relatives: Zigai, Zhang Zongyan, Liu Guangshi, Wang Yuan, Jie Yuan, and Qu Duan.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jun's collateral relatives: Zigai, Zhang Zongyan, Liu Guangshi, Wang Yuan, Jie Yuan, and Qu Duan.

sentences.zh: 張俊，字伯英，鳳翔府成紀人。

translations.literal: Zhang Jun, styled Boying, was a native of Chengji in Fengxiang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jun, styled Boying, came from Chengji in Fengxiang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 好騎射，負才氣。

translations.literal: He loved riding and archery and was proud of his talent and spirit.
translations.idiomatic: He loved riding and archery and carried himself with bold talent and spirit.

sentences.zh: 起于諸盜，年十六，為三陽弓箭手。

translations.literal: He rose among the bandits; at sixteen he became an archer of Sanyang.
translations.idiomatic: He had risen among the bandits, and at sixteen he became an archer in Sanyang.

sentences.zh: 政和七年，從討南蠻，轉都指揮使。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Zhenghe, he followed the campaign against the southern barbarians and was transferred to commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Zhenghe (1117), he joined the campaign against the southern tribes and was promoted to commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 宣和初，從攻夏人仁多泉，始授承信郎。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Xuanhe, he followed the attack on the Tangut Rendo Spring and was first granted the rank of Chengxin Lang.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Xuanhe era, he took part in the attack on the Tangut stronghold of Rendo Spring and received his first appointment as Gentleman for Upholding Trust.

sentences.zh: 平鄆州賊李太及河朔、山東武胡群寇，功最，進武德郎。

translations.literal: In pacifying the Yun Prefecture bandit Li Tai and the Wu-Hu bandits of Heshuo and Shandong, his merit was foremost, and he was promoted to Wude Lang.
translations.idiomatic: In suppressing the Yunzhou bandit Li Tai and the Wu-Hu bandits across Heshuo and Shandong, his achievements ranked first, and he was promoted to Gentleman of Martial Virtue.

sentences.zh: 靖康元年，以守東明縣功，轉武功大夫。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jingkang, for merit in defending Dongming County, he was transferred to Wugong Dafu.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Jingkang (1126), for his service in defending Dongming County, he was promoted to Grandee of Martial Achievement.

sentences.zh: 金人攻太原，城守，命制置副使种師中往援，屯榆次。

translations.literal: When the Jurchens attacked Taiyuan, the city held out; the court ordered Vice Commissioner Zhong Shizhong to relieve it and encamped at Yuci.
translations.idiomatic: When the Jurchens attacked Taiyuan, the city held firm; the court ordered Vice Commissioner Zhong Shizhong to the relief and he encamped at Yuci.

sentences.zh: 金人以數萬騎壓之。

translations.literal: The Jurchens pressed him with tens of thousands of horsemen.
translations.idiomatic: The Jurchens bore down on him with tens of thousands of cavalry.

sentences.zh: 俊時為隊將，進擊，殺傷甚眾，獲馬千匹，請乘勝要戰。

translations.literal: Jun was then a company commander; he advanced to attack, killing and wounding many, captured a thousand horses, and asked to seize the victory and give battle.
translations.idiomatic: Jun was then a company commander. He pressed the attack, inflicting heavy casualties and capturing a thousand horses, then urged that they strike while victory was in hand.

sentences.zh: 師中以日不利，急令退保。

translations.literal: Shizhong, saying the day was unfavorable, urgently ordered a retreat to safety.
translations.idiomatic: Shizhong, declaring the day ill-omened, urgently ordered a withdrawal to safety.

sentences.zh: 金人諜俊計不行，悉兵合圍，攻益急。

translations.literal: The Jurchens learned through spies that Jun's plan would not be carried out, gathered all their troops in a combined encirclement, and pressed the attack ever harder.
translations.idiomatic: Learning through spies that Jun's plan would not be adopted, the Jurchens massed their forces in a full encirclement and redoubled the assault.

sentences.zh: 榆次破，師中死之。

translations.literal: Yuci fell, and Shizhong died in the battle.
translations.idiomatic: When Yuci fell, Shizhong was killed.

sentences.zh: 俊與所部數百人突圍而出，且行且戰，至烏河川，再與敵遇，斬五百級。

translations.literal: Jun broke out with several hundred men of his command, fighting as he went; at Wuhe River he met the enemy again and beheaded five hundred.
translations.idiomatic: Jun broke out with several hundred of his men, fighting as he marched. At the Wuhe River he met the enemy again and took five hundred heads.

sentences.zh: 金人圍汴京，高宗時為兵馬大元帥，俊勒兵從信德守臣梁揚祖勤王。

translations.literal: When the Jurchens besieged Bianjing, Gaozong was then Grand Marshal of Horse and Foot; Jun led troops to follow Liang Yangzu, prefectural defender of Xinde, in rushing to the emperor's aid.
translations.idiomatic: When the Jurchens besieged Bianjing, Gaozong was serving as Grand Marshal of Horse and Foot. Jun led his troops to follow Liang Yangzu, the defender of Xinde, in marching to the emperor's rescue.

sentences.zh: 高宗見俊英偉，擢元帥府後軍統制，累功轉榮州刺史。

translations.literal: Gaozong saw that Jun was tall and imposing and promoted him to overall controller of the marshal's rear army; for accumulated merit he was transferred to prefect of Rongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozong found Jun tall and imposing and promoted him to overall controller of the marshal's rear army; for repeated achievements he was made prefect of Rongzhou.

sentences.zh: 建炎元年正月，從高宗至東平府。

translations.literal: In the first month of the first year of Jianyan, he followed Gaozong to Dongping Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the first year of Jianyan (1127), he accompanied Gaozong to Dongping Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 時劇賊李昱據兗州，命俊為都統制討之。

translations.literal: At that time the fierce bandit Li Yu held Yanzhou, and Jun was ordered as overall commander to suppress him.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the fierce bandit Li Yu held Yanzhou, and Jun was appointed overall commander to suppress him.

sentences.zh: 與數騎突圍撓戰，諸軍爭奮，賊遂殲。

translations.literal: With several horsemen he broke through the encirclement and harassed the enemy in battle; the armies vied in ardor and the bandits were annihilated.
translations.idiomatic: With a handful of horsemen he broke through the encirclement and harried the enemy; the troops rallied with fresh zeal and the bandits were wiped out.

sentences.zh: 進桂州團練使，尋加貴州防禦使。

translations.literal: He was promoted to regimental commissioner of Guizhou and soon added defender of Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to regimental commissioner of Guizhou and soon made defender of that prefecture.

sentences.zh: 中書舍人張澂，自汴京齎蠟詔，命高宗以兵付副帥還京，高宗問大計，俊曰：「此金人詐謀爾。

translations.literal: The Secretariat Drafter Zhang Cheng, bearing a wax-sealed edict from Bianjing, ordered Gaozong to hand over his troops to the deputy commander and return to the capital. Gaozong asked about the grand strategy, and Jun said: 'This is merely a Jurchen ruse.
translations.idiomatic: The Secretariat Drafter Zhang Cheng arrived from Bianjing bearing a wax-sealed edict ordering Gaozong to surrender his troops to the deputy commander and return to the capital. When Gaozong asked his grand strategy, Jun said, 'This is nothing but a Jurchen deception.

sentences.zh: 今大王居外，此天授，豈可徒往？」

translations.literal: Now that Your Highness is outside the capital, this is Heaven's gift—how can you go in vain?'
translations.idiomatic: Your Highness is now outside the capital; this is Heaven's own opportunity. How can you simply walk into it?'

sentences.zh: 因請進兵，高宗許之，遂如濟州。

translations.literal: He therefore requested an advance, Gaozong assented, and they proceeded to Jizhou.
translations.idiomatic: He then urged an advance; Gaozong agreed, and they proceeded to Jizhou.

sentences.zh: 開啟乾龍節，迫夜，有告高宗，欲俟元帥謁香劫以叛。

translations.literal: When the Qianlong Festival observances opened, near nightfall someone reported to Gaozong that the rebels intended to wait until the marshal paid his respects at the incense altar and seize him in a mutiny.
translations.idiomatic: During the opening of the Qianlong Festival rites, near nightfall someone warned Gaozong that the rebels planned to seize him in a mutiny when the marshal paid his respects at the incense altar.

sentences.zh: 群議集諸軍屯備，俊曰：「元帥不出，奸謀自破。」

translations.literal: The assembled counsels urged concentrating the armies in garrison, but Jun said: 'If the marshal does not go out, the treacherous plot will collapse of itself.'
translations.idiomatic: Counselors urged massing the armies on guard, but Jun said, 'If the marshal does not appear, the treacherous plot will collapse of itself.'

sentences.zh: 遂徙州治。

translations.literal: They thereupon moved the seat of prefectural government.
translations.idiomatic: They then moved the seat of prefectural government.

sentences.zh: 賊術窮，黎明，引軍北遁，俊勒兵追殺之。

translations.literal: The rebels' stratagems exhausted, at dawn they led their army north in flight; Jun drove his troops in pursuit and slaughtered them.
translations.idiomatic: When the rebels' schemes were exhausted, at dawn they fled north with their army. Jun drove his troops in pursuit and cut them down.

sentences.zh: 進徐州觀察使。

translations.literal: He was promoted to observation commissioner of Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to observation commissioner of Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 高宗以俊忠勞日積，遷拱衛大夫。

translations.literal: Gaozong, seeing Jun's loyal service accumulate day by day, promoted him to Court Guard Grand Master.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozong, seeing Jun's loyal service accumulate day by day, promoted him to Court Guard Grand Master.

sentences.zh: 既而汴京破，二帝北遷，人心皇皇，俊懇辭勸進，高宗涕泣不許。

translations.literal: Soon afterward Bianjing fell; the two emperors were taken north and people's hearts were fearful. Jun earnestly declined and urged accession, but Gaozong wept and refused.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward Bianjing fell. The two emperors were taken north and public fear spread. Jun earnestly urged accession, but Gaozong wept and refused.

sentences.zh: 俊曰：「大王皇帝親弟，人心所歸，當天下洶洶，不早正大位，無以稱人望。」

translations.literal: Jun said: "Your Highness is the emperor's younger brother and the people's chosen one. With the realm in turmoil, if you do not early assume the throne, you cannot meet public expectation."
translations.idiomatic: Jun said, "Your Highness is the emperor's younger brother and the people's chosen one. With the realm in turmoil, if you do not soon assume the throne, you cannot meet public expectation."

sentences.zh: 且白耿南仲奏之，表三上。

translations.literal: He also informed Geng Nanzong to memorialize, and memorials were submitted thrice.
translations.idiomatic: He also informed Geng Nanzong to memorialize, and memorials were submitted three times.

sentences.zh: 高宗發濟州，俊便道扈行。

translations.literal: Gaozong set out from Jizhou and Jun escorted him by the direct route.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozong set out from Jizhou, and Jun escorted him by the direct route.

sentences.zh: 至應天府，高宗始即位。

translations.literal: At Yingtian Prefecture Gaozong at last ascended the throne.
translations.idiomatic: At Yingtian Prefecture Gaozong at last ascended the throne.

sentences.zh: 初置御營司，以俊為御營前軍統制，遣還京迎隆祐太后。

translations.literal: The Imperial Camp Commission was first established; Jun was made overall controller of the Imperial Camp Forward Army and sent back to the capital to receive Empress Dowager Longyou.
translations.idiomatic: The Imperial Camp Commission was first established. Jun was made overall controller of the Imperial Camp Forward Army and sent back to the capital to receive Empress Dowager Longyou.

sentences.zh: 權秦鳳兵馬鈐轄。

translations.literal: Acting overall controller of horse of the Qinfeng Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: He served as acting overall controller of horse of the Qinfeng Circuit.

sentences.zh: 尋奉太后及六宮以歸，除帶御器械。

translations.literal: Soon he escorted the empress dowager and the six palaces back and was made Bearer of Imperial Apparatus.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he escorted the empress dowager and the six palaces back and was appointed Bearer of Imperial Apparatus.

sentences.zh: 時江、淮群盜蜂起，俊討杜用於淮甯，趙萬、郭青于鎮江，陳通于杭州，蔣和尚等於蘭溪，皆平之。

translations.literal: At that time bandits swarmed across the Jiang and Huai regions; Jun suppressed Du Yong at Huaining, Zhao Wan and Guo Qing at Zhenjiang, Chen Tong at Hangzhou, and Monk Jiang and others at Lanxi—all were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Bandits were rising everywhere across the Jiang and Huai regions. Jun suppressed Du Yong at Huaining, Zhao Wan and Guo Qing at Zhenjiang, Chen Tong at Hangzhou, and Monk Jiang and others at Lanxi, pacifying them all.

sentences.zh: 落階官，除正任觀察使。

translations.literal: He was stripped of provisional rank and appointed a regular observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: His provisional rank was removed and he was appointed a regular observation commissioner.

sentences.zh: 二年，升秦鳳路馬步軍副總管，尋破秀州賊數萬，縛徐明斬之。

translations.literal: In the second year he was promoted to deputy overall commander of horse and foot of the Qinfeng Circuit and soon broke several tens of thousands of bandits at Xiuzhou, bound Xu Ming, and executed him.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he was made deputy overall commander of horse and foot on the Qinfeng Circuit and soon routed tens of thousands of bandits at Xiuzhou, captured Xu Ming, and executed him.

sentences.zh: 進武寧軍承宣使。

translations.literal: He was promoted to commissioner-in-chief of the Wuning Army.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to commissioner-in-chief of the Wuning Army.

sentences.zh: 帝如揚州，召諸將議恢復，俊曰：「今敵勢方張，宜且南渡，據江為險；

translations.literal: When the emperor went to Yangzhou, he summoned the generals to discuss recovery. Jun said: 'Now the enemy's power is on the rise; it is fitting for the time to cross south and hold the river as a barrier;
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor moved to Yangzhou, he summoned the generals to discuss recovery. Jun said, 'The enemy's power is still rising. For now we should cross south and hold the Yangtze as our barrier;

sentences.zh: 練兵政，安人心，俟國勢定，大舉未晚。」

translations.literal: train troops and government, settle people's hearts, wait until the state's strength is firm, and a great campaign will not be too late.'
translations.idiomatic: train the army and administration, steady the people's hearts, and wait until the realm's strength is secure before launching a major campaign.'

sentences.zh: 俊又請移左藏庫於鎮江。

translations.literal: Jun also requested moving the Left Treasury to Zhenjiang.
translations.idiomatic: Jun also asked that the Left Treasury be moved to Zhenjiang.

sentences.zh: 既而敵掩至，已逼近甸，俊亟奏飭甲乘，從帝如臨安。

translations.literal: Soon afterward the enemy struck suddenly and had already drawn near the suburbs; Jun urgently memorialized to ready armor and chariots and followed the emperor to Lin'an.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the enemy struck without warning and had already drawn near the capital suburbs. Jun urgently memorialized to ready armor and transport and followed the emperor to Lin'an.

sentences.zh: 苗傅、劉正彥反，俊時屯兵吳江縣。

translations.literal: Miao Fu and Liu Zhengyan rebelled; Jun was then encamped at Wujiang County.
translations.idiomatic: When Miao Fu and Liu Zhengyan rebelled, Jun was encamped at Wujiang County.

sentences.zh: 傅等矯詔加俊捧日、天武四廂都指揮使，以三百人赴秦鳳，命他將領余兵。

translations.literal: Fu and the others forged an edict promoting Jun to overall commander of the four divisions of the Puri and Tianwu Armies, sending three hundred men to Qinfeng and ordering other generals to lead the remaining troops.
translations.idiomatic: Fu and his allies forged an edict promoting Jun to overall commander of the four divisions of the Puri and Tianwu Armies, ordering him to Qinfeng with three hundred men while other generals were to lead the rest.

sentences.zh: 俊知其偽，拒不受。

translations.literal: Jun knew it was false and refused to accept.
translations.idiomatic: Jun recognized the forgery and refused to obey.

sentences.zh: 三軍洶洶，俊諭之曰：「當詣張侍郎求決。」

translations.literal: The three armies were in uproar; Jun addressed them: 'We should go to Vice Director Zhang for a decision.'
translations.idiomatic: The three armies were in an uproar. Jun told them, 'We must go to Vice Director Zhang for a decision.'

sentences.zh: 即引所部八千人至平江。

translations.literal: He immediately led eight thousand of his troops to Pingjiang.
translations.idiomatic: He immediately led eight thousand of his men to Pingjiang.

sentences.zh: 張浚語俊以傅等欲危社稷，泣數行下，俊大慟。

translations.literal: Zhang Jun told Jun that Fu and the others intended to endanger the altars of state and wept for many lines; Jun was deeply grieved.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jun told Jun that Fu and his allies meant to endanger the throne and wept at length; Jun was deeply shaken.

sentences.zh: 浚諭以決策起兵問罪，俊泣拜，且曰：「此須侍郎濟以機術，毋驚動乘輿。」

translations.literal: Jun urged a decision to raise troops and demand justice; Jun wept and bowed and said: 'This requires the Vice Director to supply strategy so as not to alarm the imperial carriage.'
translations.idiomatic: Jun urged him to decide on raising troops to punish the rebels. Jun wept, bowed, and said, 'This requires your strategic guidance, Vice Director, so that the imperial carriage is not alarmed.'

sentences.zh: 呂頤浩至，俊見之，亦涕泣曰：「今日惟以一死報國。」

translations.literal: When Lü Yihao arrived, Jun saw him and also wept, saying: 'Today I can repay the state only with my death.'
translations.idiomatic: When Lü Yihao arrived, Jun met him in tears and said, 'Today I can repay the state only with my life.'

sentences.zh: 劉光世以所部至，俊釋舊憾。

translations.literal: Liu Guangshi arrived with his command, and Jun set aside old grievances.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Guangshi arrived with his troops, and Jun put aside old resentments.

sentences.zh: 韓世忠來自海上，俊借一軍與之俱。

translations.literal: Han Shizhong came from the sea, and Jun lent him one army to march together.
translations.idiomatic: Han Shizhong came from the coast, and Jun lent him one army to march with him.

sentences.zh: 世忠為前軍，俊以精兵翼之，光世次之。

translations.literal: Shizhong was the vanguard; Jun flanked him with picked troops, and Guangshi followed.
translations.idiomatic: Shizhong led the vanguard; Jun protected his flank with elite troops while Guangshi came behind.

sentences.zh: 戰于臨平，傅等兵敗，開城以出。

translations.literal: They fought at Linping; Fu and the others were defeated and opened the city to let them in.
translations.idiomatic: They fought at Linping. Fu and his allies were defeated and opened the city.

sentences.zh: 世忠、俊、光世入城，見於內殿，帝嘉勞久之，拜鎮西軍節度使、御前右軍都統制，尋為浙東制置使。

translations.literal: Shizhong, Jun, and Guangshi entered the city and were received in the inner hall; the emperor praised and rewarded them at length, appointing Jun military governor of the Zhenxi Army and overall commander of the imperial right army, and soon making him pacification commissioner of Zhedong.
translations.idiomatic: Shizhong, Jun, and Guangshi entered the city and were received in the inner hall. The emperor praised them at length, appointing Jun military governor of the Zhenxi Army and overall commander of the imperial right army, and soon making him pacification commissioner of Zhedong.

sentences.zh: 金人分兵深入，渡江攻浙，杜充棄建康，韓世忠自鎮江退保江陰。

translations.literal: The Jurchens divided their forces for a deep advance, crossed the river to attack Zhejiang; Du Chong abandoned Jiankang, and Han Shizhong withdrew from Zhenjiang to hold Jiangyin.
translations.idiomatic: The Jurchens divided their forces for a deep thrust, crossed the Yangtze to attack Zhejiang, Du Chong abandoned Jiankang, and Han Shizhong withdrew from Zhenjiang to hold Jiangyin.

sentences.zh: 帝如明州，俊自越州引兵至。

translations.literal: The emperor went to Mingzhou; Jun led troops from Yuezhou to join him.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor moved to Mingzhou; Jun led troops from Yuezhou to join him.

sentences.zh: 兀朮攻臨安，帝御樓船如溫州，留俊於明州以拒敵。

translations.literal: Wuzhu attacked Lin'an; the emperor took a tower ship to Wenzhou and left Jun at Mingzhou to resist the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: When Wuzhu attacked Lin'an, the emperor sailed to Wenzhou on a tower ship and left Jun at Mingzhou to hold the enemy.

sentences.zh: 帝賜親劄曰：「朕非卿，則倡義誰先；

translations.literal: The emperor bestowed a personal letter saying: 'Were it not for you, who would have taken the lead in this righteous cause;
translations.idiomatic: The emperor sent a personal letter saying, 'Without you, who would have led this righteous cause?

sentences.zh: 卿捨朕，則前功俱廢。

translations.literal: if you abandon me, all our earlier achievements will be wasted.
translations.idiomatic: If you abandon me, all our earlier achievements will come to nothing.

sentences.zh: 宜戮力共扞敵兵，一戰成功，當封王爵。」

translations.literal: Strive together to repel the enemy; if you win in one battle, a princely title will be granted.'
translations.idiomatic: Fight together to repel the enemy. Win one decisive battle and a princely title will be yours.'

sentences.zh: 癸卯除夕，金兵至城下，俊使統制劉寶與戰，兵少卻，其將黨用、丘橫死之，於是統制楊沂中、田師中、統領趙密皆殊死戰。

translations.literal: On New Year's Eve of the guimao day, Jurchen troops reached the city; Jun sent overall controller Liu Bao to fight. The troops fell back slightly; his generals Dang Yong and Qiu Heng were killed. Then overall controllers Yang Yizhong and Tian Shizhong and commander Zhao Mi all fought to the death.
translations.idiomatic: On New Year's Eve of the guimao day, Jurchen troops reached the walls. Jun sent overall controller Liu Bao to fight. The troops gave ground slightly; his generals Dang Yong and Qiu Heng were killed. Then overall controllers Yang Yizhong and Tian Shizhong and commander Zhao Mi all fought to the death.

sentences.zh: 沂中舍舟登岸力戰，殿帥李質以班直來助，守臣劉洪道率州兵射其旁，大破之，殺數千人。

translations.literal: Yizhong abandoned his boat, went ashore, and fought with all his strength; Palace Commander Li Zhi came with the guard to assist, and prefect Liu Hongdao led the prefectural troops to shoot from the flank; they routed the enemy and killed several thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Yizhong left his boat, fought ashore with all his strength, and Palace Commander Li Zhi came with the guard to assist. Prefect Liu Hongdao led the prefectural troops to fire from the flank. The enemy was routed and several thousand were killed.

sentences.zh: 金呼人至砦計事，俊令小校往。

translations.literal: The Jurchens called someone to the camp to discuss affairs; Jun sent a junior officer.
translations.idiomatic: The Jurchens summoned someone to their camp to negotiate; Jun sent a junior officer.

sentences.zh: 金人與語，欲如越州請降，俊拒之。

translations.literal: When the Jurchens spoke with him, they wished to go to Yuezhou to sue for surrender; Jun refused.
translations.idiomatic: In talks the Jurchens wished to go to Yuezhou to offer surrender; Jun refused.

sentences.zh: 戒將士毋驕惰，慮敵必再至，下令清野，多以輕舟伏弩，閉關自守。

translations.literal: He warned the officers and men against pride and slackness, fearing the enemy would return, ordered the countryside cleared, posted many light boats with crossbows in ambush, and closed the passes in self-defense.
translations.idiomatic: He warned his officers and men against pride and slackness, expecting the enemy would return, ordered the countryside stripped bare, posted many light boats with hidden crossbows, and shut the passes to hold the city.

sentences.zh: 四年正旦，忽西風起，金人乘之，果復攻明州。

translations.literal: On New Year's Day of the fourth year, a west wind suddenly rose; the Jurchens seized it and indeed attacked Mingzhou again.
translations.idiomatic: On New Year's Day of the fourth year a west wind suddenly rose. The Jurchens seized the advantage and attacked Mingzhou again.

sentences.zh: 俊與劉洪道坐城樓上，遣兵掩擊，殺傷大當。

translations.literal: Jun and Liu Hongdao sat on the city tower and sent troops in a surprise attack; casualties on both sides were heavy.
translations.idiomatic: Jun and Liu Hongdao sat on the city tower and sent troops in a surprise attack; casualties on both sides were heavy.

sentences.zh: 金人奔北，死于江者無數，夜拔砦去，屯余姚，且請濟師於兀朮。

translations.literal: The Jurchens fled north; countless died in the river. At night they broke camp and withdrew, encamping at Yuyao and requesting reinforcements from Wuzhu.
translations.idiomatic: The Jurchens fled north and countless drowned in the river. That night they broke camp, withdrew to Yuyao, and asked Wuzhu for reinforcements.

sentences.zh: 後七日，敵再至，俊引兵趨入台州，明州居民去者十七八。

translations.literal: Seven days later the enemy came again; Jun led his troops in haste into Taizhou, and seven or eight tenths of Mingzhou's residents fled.
translations.idiomatic: Seven days later the enemy returned. Jun led his troops in haste into Taizhou, and seven or eight tenths of Mingzhou's residents fled.

sentences.zh: 未幾，江浙群盜蜂起，授俊兩浙西路、江南東路制置使，以所部招收群盜，命後軍統制陳思恭隸之，且令兩浙宣撫使周望以兵屬俊，劉光世、韓世忠之外，諸將皆受節度。

translations.literal: Before long bandits swarmed across Jiangsu and Zhejiang; Jun was appointed pacification commissioner of western Zhejiang and eastern Jiangnan, ordered to recruit bandits with his command, with rear-army overall controller Chen Sigong placed under him; the two-Zhejiang pacification commissioner Zhou Wang was also ordered to place troops under Jun. Apart from Liu Guangshi and Han Shizhong, all generals were placed under his command.
translations.idiomatic: Before long bandits swarmed across Jiangsu and Zhejiang. Jun was made pacification commissioner of western Zhejiang and eastern Jiangnan and ordered to recruit bandits with his own troops; rear-army overall controller Chen Sigong was placed under him, and two-Zhejiang pacification commissioner Zhou Wang was ordered to place his troops under Jun as well. Apart from Liu Guangshi and Han Shizhong, every general came under his command.

sentences.zh: 六月，改御前五軍為神武軍，俊即本軍為神武右軍都統制，除檢校少保、定江昭慶軍節度使。

translations.literal: In the sixth month the imperial five armies were reorganized as the Shenwu Army; Jun's own army became the overall command of the Shenwu Right Army, and he was appointed honorary junior guardian and military governor of the Dingjiang Zhaqing Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month the imperial five armies were reorganized as the Shenwu Army. Jun's own force became the Shenwu Right Army under his overall command, and he was appointed honorary junior guardian and military governor of the Dingjiang Zhaqing Army.

sentences.zh: 十月，浙西群盜悉平，改江南招討使。

translations.literal: In the tenth month bandits in western Zhejiang were all pacified, and his title was changed to Jiangnan pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month bandits in western Zhejiang were all pacified, and his title was changed to Jiangnan pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 紹興元年，帝至會稽。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shaoxing, the emperor arrived at Kuaiji.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Shaoxing (1131), the emperor arrived at Kuaiji.

sentences.zh: 時金人殘亂之余，孔彥舟據武陵，張用據襄漢；

translations.literal: At that time, in the aftermath of Jurchen devastation, Kong Yanzho held Wuling and Zhang Yong held Xiang-Han;
translations.idiomatic: At that time, amid the wreckage left by the Jurchens, Kong Yanzho held Wuling and Zhang Yong held the Xiang-Han region;

sentences.zh: 李成尤悍，強據江、淮、湖湘十余州，連兵數萬，有席捲東南意，多造符讖蠱惑中外，圍江州久未解，時方患之。

translations.literal: Li Cheng was especially fierce, forcibly holding more than ten prefectures across the Jiang, Huai, and Huxiang regions with tens of thousands of linked troops, intending to sweep the southeast; he produced many prophecies to delude court and country, besieged Jiangzhou for a long time without lifting the siege, and the court was then troubled by him.
translations.idiomatic: Li Cheng was especially fierce. He forcibly held more than ten prefectures across the Jiang, Huai, and lake-Xiang region with linked armies numbering in the tens of thousands, aiming to sweep the southeast. He spread prophecies to deceive court and country, besieged Jiangzhou for a long time, and the court was deeply troubled.

sentences.zh: 范宗尹請遣將致討，俊慨然請行，遂改江、淮路招討使。

translations.literal: Fan Zongyin requested dispatching a general to suppress him; Jun eagerly volunteered and was thereupon made pacification commissioner of the Jiang-Huai Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Fan Zongyin asked that a general be sent to suppress him. Jun eagerly volunteered and was made pacification commissioner of the Jiang-Huai Circuit.

sentences.zh: 成黨馬進在筠州。

translations.literal: Li Cheng's partisan Ma Jin was at Yuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Li Cheng's partisan Ma Jin was at Yuzhou.

sentences.zh: 豫章介江、筠之間，俊聞命就道，急趨豫章，且曰：「我已得洪州，破賊決矣。」

translations.literal: Yuzhang lay between the river and Yuzhou; Jun, upon receiving the order, set out at once and hurried to Yuzhang, saying: 'I have already taken Hongzhou; breaking the bandits is settled.'
translations.idiomatic: Yuzhang lay between the river and Yuzzhou. Upon receiving his orders Jun set out at once and hurried to Yuzhang, declaring, 'I have already taken Hongzhou; the bandits are as good as broken.'

sentences.zh: 乃斂兵，若無人者，金鼓不動，令將士登城者斬。

translations.literal: He then restrained his troops as if no one were there; drums and gongs were not sounded, and he ordered that any officer or soldier who mounted the wall be executed.
translations.idiomatic: He then held his troops in check as if no one were present: drums and gongs were silent, and he ordered death for any soldier who mounted the wall.

sentences.zh: 居月餘，進以大書牒來索戰，俊以細書狀報之，賊以俊為怯。

translations.literal: After more than a month Jin sent a letter in large script demanding battle; Jun replied in fine script, and the bandits thought Jun was timid.
translations.idiomatic: After more than a month Jin sent a letter in large script demanding battle; Jun answered in fine script, and the bandits took Jun for a coward.

sentences.zh: 俊諜知賊怠，乃議戰。

translations.literal: Jun learned through spies that the bandits had grown slack and then planned battle.
translations.idiomatic: When spies reported that the bandits had grown slack, Jun planned to give battle.

sentences.zh: 岳飛為先鋒，楊沂中由上流徑絕生米渡，出賊不意，追奔七十里，至筠州。

translations.literal: Yue Fei was vanguard; Yang Yizhong, from upstream, cut straight across the Shengmi Ford, caught the bandits unawares, pursued them seventy li, and reached Yuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Yue Fei served as vanguard. Yang Yizhong, coming from upstream, cut straight across the Shengmi Ford, caught the bandits unawares, pursued them seventy li, and reached Yuzhou.

sentences.zh: 賊背筠河而陣，俊用楊沂中計，親以步兵當其前，精騎數千授沂中及陳思恭，俾從山后夾擊，以午為期。

translations.literal: The bandits formed their line with the Yun River at their backs; Jun used Yang Yizhong's plan, personally taking infantry against their front and assigning several thousand picked horsemen to Yizhong and Chen Sigong to strike from behind the mountains in a pincer, with noon as the rendezvous.
translations.idiomatic: The bandits formed their line with the Yun River at their backs. Following Yang Yizhong's plan, Jun personally led infantry against their front while assigning several thousand picked horsemen to Yizhong and Chen Sigong to strike from behind the mountains, with noon as the rendezvous.

sentences.zh: 俊與賊鏖戰至午，精騎自山馳下，賊駭亂退走，大敗。

translations.literal: Jun fought the bandits in fierce battle until noon; the picked horsemen charged down the mountain, the bandits panicked and fled, and were utterly defeated.
translations.idiomatic: Jun fought the bandits in fierce battle until noon. Then the picked horsemen charged down the mountain; the bandits broke in panic and were utterly defeated.

sentences.zh: 既復筠州、臨江軍，捷奏，帝賜御筆，謂：「宜乘賊勢已衰，當官軍已振，驅除剿戮，速收全功。」

translations.literal: After recovering Yuzhou and Linjiang Prefecture, a victory memorial was sent; the emperor bestowed an imperial brush note saying: 'You should seize the moment when the bandits' strength has waned and the government armies are rallied, drive them out, exterminate them, and quickly complete the victory.'
translations.idiomatic: After Yuzhou and Linjiang Prefecture were recovered, a victory memorial was sent. The emperor wrote in his own hand: 'Seize the moment while the bandits' strength has waned and the government armies are rallied; drive them out, exterminate them, and finish the victory quickly.'

sentences.zh: 俊未拜親詔，已追至北奉新樓子莊。

translations.literal: Before Jun could acknowledge the imperial edict, he had already pursued to Beifengxin at Louzi Village.
translations.idiomatic: Before Jun could acknowledge the imperial edict, he had already pursued to Louzi Village in northern Fengxin.

sentences.zh: 賊党商元據草山，挾險設伏，俊遣步兵從間道直趨山椒，殺伏奪險，乘勝追至江州。

translations.literal: The bandit partisan Shang Yuan held Caoshan, relying on the terrain to set an ambush; Jun sent infantry by a hidden path straight to the mountain crest, killed the ambushers and seized the heights, and pressing the victory pursued to Jiangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The bandit partisan Shang Yuan held Caoshan and set an ambush in the difficult terrain. Jun sent infantry by a hidden path straight to the ridge, killed the ambushers and seized the heights, then pressed the victory in pursuit to Jiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 成勢迫，絕江而遁，號俊為「張鐵山」。

translations.literal: Cheng's position was desperate; he crossed the river in flight and called Jun 'Iron Mountain Zhang.'
translations.idiomatic: Cheng's position was desperate. He fled across the river and nicknamed Jun 'Iron Mountain Zhang.'

sentences.zh: 復江州。

translations.literal: Jiangzhou was recovered.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangzhou was recovered.

sentences.zh: 已而興國軍等處群盜聞俊兵至，皆遁去。

translations.literal: Before long, bandits at Xingguo Prefecture and elsewhere, hearing that Jun's army had arrived, all fled.
translations.idiomatic: Before long, bandits at Xingguo Prefecture and elsewhere, hearing that Jun's army had arrived, all fled.

sentences.zh: 俊引兵渡江至黃梅縣，親與成戰。

translations.literal: Jun led his army across the river to Huangmei County and personally fought Cheng.
translations.idiomatic: Jun led his army across the river to Huangmei County and fought Cheng in person.

sentences.zh: 成懲奉新失險之敗，據石矢坡，憑山以木石投人。

translations.literal: Cheng, chastened by his defeat at Fengxin when he lost the heights, held Shishi Slope, relying on the mountain to hurl timber and stones at men.
translations.idiomatic: Chastened by his defeat at Fengxin when he lost the heights, Cheng held Shishi Slope and, relying on the mountain, hurled timber and stones down on his attackers.

sentences.zh: 俊先遣遊卒進退，若爭險狀以誑賊，俊親冒矢石，帥眾攻險，賊眾數萬俱潰，馬進為追兵所殺，成北走降劉豫，諸郡悉平。

translations.literal: Jun first sent skirmishers forward and back as if contesting the heights to deceive the bandits; Jun personally braved arrows and stones, led the masses to storm the heights, and the bandit host of tens of thousands all collapsed. Ma Jin was killed by pursuing troops; Cheng fled north and surrendered to Liu Yu, and all prefectures were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Jun first sent skirmishers feinting forward and back as if contesting the heights to deceive the bandits. Then he personally braved arrows and stones, led the assault on the heights, and the bandit host of tens of thousands collapsed. Ma Jin was killed by pursuing troops; Cheng fled north and surrendered to Liu Yu, and all the prefectures were pacified.

sentences.zh: 拜太尉。

translations.literal: He was appointed Grand Marshal.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Grand Marshal.

sentences.zh: 四年十月，金人與劉豫分道入侵。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the fourth year, the Jurchens and Liu Yu invaded by separate routes.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the fourth year, the Jurchens and Liu Yu invaded by separate routes.

sentences.zh: 先是諜至，舉朝震恐，或請他幸。

translations.literal: Earlier, when spies arrived, the whole court was shaken with fear, and some urged the emperor to move his residence elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: When spies first arrived, the whole court was shaken with fear, and some urged the emperor to move his residence elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 俊謂趙鼎曰：「避將何之？

translations.literal: Jun said to Zhao Ding: 'Where would we flee by avoiding?
translations.idiomatic: Jun said to Zhao Ding, 'Where would flight take us?

sentences.zh: 惟向前進一步，庶可脫。

translations.literal: Only by advancing one step forward might we escape.
translations.idiomatic: Only by advancing one step further might we escape.

sentences.zh: 當聚天下兵守平江，徐為計。」

translations.literal: We should gather the armies of the realm to hold Pingjiang and plan slowly.'
translations.idiomatic: We should gather the armies of the realm to hold Pingjiang and plan from there.'

sentences.zh: 鼎曰：「公言避非策，是也；

translations.literal: Ding said: 'Your statement that avoidance is no strategy is correct;
translations.idiomatic: Ding said, 'You are right that flight is no strategy;

sentences.zh: 以天下兵守一州，非也。

translations.literal: to gather the armies of the realm to hold one prefecture is not correct.
translations.idiomatic: but to mass the armies of the realm to hold a single prefecture is not right either.

sentences.zh: 公但堅前議足矣。」

translations.literal: Your Lordship need only hold to your earlier counsel.'
translations.idiomatic: Your Lordship need only hold firm to your earlier counsel.'

sentences.zh: 遂以俊為兩浙西路、江南東路宣撫使，屯建康。

translations.literal: Jun was thereupon made pacification commissioner of western Zhejiang and eastern Jiangnan and encamped at Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: Jun was then made pacification commissioner of western Zhejiang and eastern Jiangnan and encamped at Jiankang.

sentences.zh: 既而改淮西宣撫使。

translations.literal: Soon afterward his title was changed to Huai West pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward his title was changed to Huai West pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 瀕江相距逾月，敵不得入。

translations.literal: Along the river they faced each other for more than a month, and the enemy could not enter.
translations.idiomatic: For more than a month they faced each other along the river, and the enemy could not break through.

sentences.zh: 俊遣張宗顏潛渡至六合，出其背。

translations.literal: Jun sent Zhang Zongyan to cross secretly to Liuhe and strike from behind.
translations.idiomatic: Jun sent Zhang Zongyan to cross secretly to Liuhe and strike from the enemy's rear.

sentences.zh: 敵將引去，俊繼遣王進曰：「敵既無留心，必逕渡淮去，可速及其未濟擊之。」

translations.literal: The enemy general was about to withdraw; Jun then sent Wang Jin, saying: 'Since the enemy no longer means to stay, they will surely cross the Huai directly north; we must quickly strike them before they finish crossing.'
translations.idiomatic: When the enemy general was about to withdraw, Jun sent Wang Jin with these orders: 'The enemy no longer means to stay and will surely cross the Huai straight north. Strike them before they finish crossing.'

sentences.zh: 進往，敵果北渡，遂薄諸淮，大敗之，獲其酋程師回、張延壽以獻。

translations.literal: Jin went; the enemy indeed crossed north, and he pressed them at the Huai, inflicting a great defeat and capturing their chieftains Cheng Shihui and Zhang Yanshou to present.
translations.idiomatic: Jin went. The enemy did cross north, and he pressed them at the Huai, inflicting a great defeat and capturing their chieftains Cheng Shihui and Zhang Yanshou to present as trophies.

sentences.zh: 五年，劉麟入寇，俊與楊沂中合兵拒於泗州。

translations.literal: In the fifth year Liu Lin invaded; Jun and Yang Yizhong combined forces to resist at Sizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year Liu Lin invaded. Jun and Yang Yizhong combined forces to resist at Sizhou.

sentences.zh: 六年，改崇信、奉甯軍節度使。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he was made military governor of the Chongxin and Fengning armies.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he was made military governor of the Chongxin and Fengning armies.

sentences.zh: 劉麟兵十余萬犯濠、壽，詔並以淮西屬俊，楊存中亦聽節制，與俊合兵拒敵。

translations.literal: Liu Lin's army of more than a hundred thousand attacked Hao and Shou; an edict placed all of Huai West under Jun, and Yang Cunzhong was also placed under his command to combine forces against the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Lin led more than a hundred thousand men against Hao and Shou. An edict placed all of Huai West under Jun, and Yang Cunzhong was also ordered to obey his command so they could combine against the enemy.

sentences.zh: 俊分遣存中與張宗顏、王瑋、田師中等，自定遠軍次越家坊，遇劉猊左右軍，擊走之。

translations.literal: Jun separately dispatched Cunzhong with Zhang Zongyan, Wang Wei, and Tian Shizhong from Dingyuan Prefecture to encamp at Yuejiafang, where they met Liu Ya's left and right armies and drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: Jun sent Cunzhong with Zhang Zongyan, Wang Wei, and Tian Shizhong from Dingyuan Prefecture to encamp at Yuejiafang, where they met Liu Ya's left and right armies and drove them off.

sentences.zh: 俊率大軍鼓行而前，至李家灣遇猊大兵，與戰，殺獲略盡，降者萬餘人，猊僅以身免。

translations.literal: Jun led the main army beating drums as it advanced; at Lijiawan he met Ya's main force, fought, killed and captured nearly all, more than ten thousand surrendered, and Ya barely escaped with his life.
translations.idiomatic: Jun led the main army forward with drums beating. At Lijiawan he met Ya's main force, fought, killed and captured nearly all; more than ten thousand surrendered, and Ya barely escaped with his life.

sentences.zh: 拜少保，加鎮洮、崇信、奉甯軍節度使。

translations.literal: He was appointed junior guardian and additionally made military governor of the Zhentao, Chongxin, and Fengning armies.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed junior guardian and additionally made military governor of the Zhentao, Chongxin, and Fengning armies.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「卿議論持重，深達敵情；

translations.literal: The emperor said: 'Your counsel is steady and you deeply understand the enemy's situation;
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, 'Your counsel is steady and you understand the enemy deeply;

sentences.zh: 兼聞挽強之士數萬，報國如此，朕復何慮。」

translations.literal: I also hear you have tens of thousands of strong archers; with such service to the state, what have I to worry about?'
translations.idiomatic: I also hear you have tens of thousands of strong archers. With such service to the state, what have I to fear?'

sentences.zh: 又曰：「群臣謂朕待卿獨厚，其仰體眷懷，益思勉勵。」

translations.literal: He also said: 'The ministers say I treat you especially well; you should respond to my favor and strive all the harder.'
translations.idiomatic: He also said, 'The ministers say I treat you especially well. Respond to my favor and strive all the harder.'

sentences.zh: 七年，改淮南西路宣撫使，置司盱眙。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was made Huainan West pacification commissioner and established his headquarters at Xuyi.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he was made Huainan West pacification commissioner and established his headquarters at Xuyi.

sentences.zh: 俊與韓世忠入見，議移屯。

translations.literal: Jun and Han Shizhong had an audience and discussed moving encampments.
translations.idiomatic: Jun and Han Shizhong had an audience and discussed relocating their camps.

sentences.zh: 秦檜奏：「臣嘗語世忠、俊，陛下倚此二大將，譬如兩虎，固當各守藩籬，使寇不敢近。」

translations.literal: Qin Hui memorialized: 'I once told Shizhong and Jun that Your Majesty relies on these two great generals like two tigers; each should hold his own barrier so that bandits dare not approach.'
translations.idiomatic: Qin Hui memorialized, 'I once told Shizhong and Jun that Your Majesty relies on these two great generals like two tigers. Each should hold his own barrier so that enemies dare not approach.'

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「正如左右手，豈可一手不盡力邪？」

translations.literal: The emperor said: 'Just like left and right hands—how can one hand not exert itself?'
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, 'They are like my left and right hands. How can one hand fail to do its part?'

sentences.zh: 命俊自盱眙屯廬州。

translations.literal: He ordered Jun to encamp at Luzhou from Xuyi.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered Jun to move from Xuyi and encamp at Luzhou.

sentences.zh: 八年，金人請寢兵，許之。

translations.literal: In the eighth year the Jurchens requested a ceasefire, and it was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year the Jurchens requested a ceasefire, and the court agreed.

sentences.zh: 賜俊「安民靖難功臣」，拜少傅。

translations.literal: Jun was granted the title 'Meritorious Minister Who Pacifies the People and Quells Rebellion' and appointed junior tutor.
translations.idiomatic: Jun was granted the title "Meritorious Minister Who Pacifies the People and Quells Rebellion" and appointed junior tutor.

sentences.zh: 九年冬，金復渝盟，再破河南，圖順昌府，命俊策應劉錡。

translations.literal: In the winter of the ninth year the Jurchens broke the treaty again, retook Henan, and targeted Shunchang Prefecture; Jun was ordered to support Liu Qi.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of the ninth year the Jurchens broke the treaty again, retook Henan, and targeted Shunchang Prefecture. Jun was ordered to support Liu Qi.

sentences.zh: 俊督軍渡江，金人引退。

translations.literal: Jun supervised the army in crossing the river, and the Jurchens withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Jun supervised the army in crossing the river, and the Jurchens withdrew.

sentences.zh: 繼而金人三路都統自東、南兩京分道來侵，抵亳州北渡河，俊收宿、亳諸軍擊之，盡復衛真、鹿邑等地，師還。

translations.literal: Then the Jurchens' three-route overall commanders invaded by separate routes from the eastern and southern capitals, reached north of Bozhou and crossed the river; Jun gathered the armies of Su and Bo to strike them, fully recovered Weizhen, Luyi, and other places, and the army returned.
translations.idiomatic: Then the Jurchens' three-route overall commanders invaded by separate routes from the eastern and southern capitals, reached north of Bozhou and crossed the river. Jun gathered the armies of Su and Bo to strike them, fully recovered Weizhen, Luyi, and other places, and returned.

sentences.zh: 十年，酈瓊在亳州，俊以大軍至城父，都統制王德下符離，乘勝趨亳與俊合。

translations.literal: In the tenth year Li Qiong was at Bozhou; Jun brought the main army to Chengfù, and overall commander Wang De took Fuli, pressed the victory toward Bo, and joined Jun.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year Li Qiong was at Bozhou. Jun brought the main army to Chengfù while overall commander Wang De took Fuli, pressed the victory toward Bo, and joined Jun.

sentences.zh: 俊引軍入城，金人棄城遁，父老列香花迎俊，遂復亳州，留統制宋超守之。

translations.literal: Jun led the army into the city; the Jurchens abandoned the city and fled. The elders lined up with incense and flowers to welcome Jun; Bozhou was recovered, and overall controller Song Chao was left to hold it.
translations.idiomatic: Jun led his army into the city. The Jurchens abandoned it and fled. The elders lined the streets with incense and flowers to welcome him. Bozhou was recovered, and overall controller Song Chao was left to hold it.

sentences.zh: 俊引軍還壽春，進少師，封濟國公。

translations.literal: Jun led the army back to Shouchun, was promoted to junior master, and enfeoffed as Duke of Ji.
translations.idiomatic: Jun led the army back to Shouchun, was promoted to junior master, and enfeoffed as Duke of Ji.

sentences.zh: 十一年二月，兀朮入合肥，漸攻曆陽，江東制置大使葉夢得見俊，請速出軍。

translations.literal: In the second month of the eleventh year Wuzhu entered Hefei and gradually attacked Liyang; Jiangdong pacification grand commissioner Ye Mengde saw Jun and asked him to send troops out quickly.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the eleventh year Wuzhu entered Hefei and gradually pressed Liyang. Jiangdong pacification grand commissioner Ye Mengde saw Jun and urged him to send troops out at once.

sentences.zh: 俊遣兵渡江，諭諸將曰：「先得和州者勝。」

translations.literal: Jun sent troops across the river and told the generals: 'Whoever takes Hezhou first wins.'
translations.idiomatic: Jun sent troops across the river and told the generals, 'Whoever takes Hezhou first wins.'

sentences.zh: 王德願為諸軍先，士鼓噪而行。

translations.literal: Wang De volunteered to lead the armies; the soldiers cheered as they marched.
translations.idiomatic: Wang De volunteered to lead the armies, and the soldiers cheered as they marched.

sentences.zh: 敵已據之，德率眾渡採石先登，俊宿中流。

translations.literal: The enemy already held it; De led the masses across Caishi and climbed first, while Jun encamped midstream.
translations.idiomatic: The enemy already held it. De led the masses across at Caishi and climbed first while Jun encamped midstream.

sentences.zh: 德抵城下，金人退屯昭關。

translations.literal: De reached the foot of the wall; the Jurchens withdrew to encamp at Zhaoguan.
translations.idiomatic: When De reached the foot of the wall, the Jurchens withdrew to Zhaoguan.

sentences.zh: 後三日，復敗金將韓常於含山。

translations.literal: Three days later he again defeated the Jurchen general Han Chang at Hanshan.
translations.idiomatic: Three days later he again defeated the Jurchen general Han Chang at Hanshan.

sentences.zh: 命關師古復巢縣，遂復昭關。

translations.literal: He ordered Guan Shigu to recover Chaoxian and then recovered Zhaoguan.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered Guan Shigu to recover Chaoxian and then recovered Zhaoguan.

sentences.zh: 使左軍統制趙密偃兵篁竹，出六丈河以分金勢。

translations.literal: He had left-army overall controller Zhao Mi hide troops among bamboo groves and emerge at the Liuzhang River to divide the Jurchen force.
translations.idiomatic: He had left-army overall controller Zhao Mi hide troops among bamboo groves and emerge at the Liuzhang River to divide the Jurchen force.

sentences.zh: 張守忠以五百騎敗金人于全椒。

translations.literal: Zhang Shouzhong with five hundred horsemen defeated the Jurchens at Quanjiao.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Shouzhong with five hundred horsemen defeated the Jurchens at Quanjiao.

sentences.zh: 未幾，敵斷石樑以拒俊，俊疾作，力疾引眾涉流登岸，追擊之。

translations.literal: Before long the enemy cut the stone bridge to block Jun; Jun fell ill but, forcing himself despite illness, led the masses across the stream to the bank and pursued.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the enemy cut the stone bridge to block Jun. Jun fell ill but, forcing himself despite illness, led his men across the stream to the bank and pursued.

sentences.zh: 王德與楊存中、劉錡會兵，敗金人於柘皋。

translations.literal: Wang De joined forces with Yang Cunzhong and Liu Qi and defeated the Jurchens at Zhegao.
translations.idiomatic: Wang De joined forces with Yang Cunzhong and Liu Qi and defeated the Jurchens at Zhegao.

sentences.zh: 拜樞密使。

translations.literal: He was appointed commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 俊知朝廷欲罷兵，首請納所統兵。

translations.literal: Jun knew the court wished to halt the war and was the first to request surrendering the troops under his command.
translations.idiomatic: Jun knew the court wished to halt the war and was the first to offer to surrender the troops under his command.

sentences.zh: 議賞宿、亳功，俊部將王德、田師中、劉寶、李橫、馬立、張澥六人同日首受上賞。

translations.literal: When rewards for the Su and Bo achievements were discussed, six of Jun's subordinate generals—Wang De, Tian Shizhong, Liu Bao, Li Heng, Ma Li, and Zhang Xie—on the same day were the first to receive the highest rewards.
translations.idiomatic: When rewards for the Su and Bo campaign were discussed, six of Jun's subordinate generals—Wang De, Tian Shizhong, Liu Bao, Li Heng, Ma Li, and Zhang Xie—were the first on the same day to receive the highest rewards.

sentences.zh: 俊力贊和議，與秦檜意合，言無不從。

translations.literal: Jun strongly supported the peace agreement; his views accorded with Qin Hui's, and nothing he said was rejected.
translations.idiomatic: Jun strongly supported the peace agreement. His views accorded with Qin Hui's, and nothing he said was rejected.

sentences.zh: 薦士大夫監司、郡守者甚眾，雖劉子羽自謫籍起家，亦俊力也。

translations.literal: He recommended many scholar-officials as circuit intendants and prefects; even Liu Ziyu's rise from demoted status was due to Jun's effort.
translations.idiomatic: He recommended many scholar-officials as circuit intendants and prefects. Even Liu Ziyu's rise from demoted status was due to Jun's effort.

sentences.zh: 加太傅，封廣國公，尋進益國公。

translations.literal: He was promoted to grand tutor and enfeoffed as Duke of Guang, and soon advanced to Duke of Yi.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to grand tutor and enfeoffed as Duke of Guang, and soon advanced to Duke of Yi.

sentences.zh: 十二年十一月，以殿中侍御史江邈論之，罷為鎮洮、甯武、奉甯軍節度使，充醴泉觀使。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the twelfth year, on the remonstrance of Palace Remonstrance Attendant Jiang Miao, he was dismissed as military governor of the Zhentao, Ningwu, and Fengning armies and appointed director of the Liquan Abbey.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the twelfth year, on the remonstrance of Palace Remonstrance Attendant Jiang Miao, he was dismissed as military governor of the Zhentao, Ningwu, and Fengning armies and appointed director of the Liquan Abbey.

sentences.zh: 初，檜以俊助和議，德之，故盡罷諸將，以兵權付俊。

translations.literal: Earlier, because Jun had helped the peace agreement, Hui favored him and therefore dismissed all the other generals and entrusted military power to Jun.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, because Jun had helped the peace agreement, Hui favored him and therefore dismissed all the other generals and entrusted military power to Jun alone.

sentences.zh: 歲餘，俊無去意，故檜使邈攻之。

translations.literal: After more than a year Jun showed no intention of leaving, so Hui had Miao attack him.
translations.idiomatic: After more than a year Jun showed no intention of stepping down, so Hui had Miao attack him.

sentences.zh: 尋進封清河郡王，奉朝請。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was further enfeoffed as Prince of Qinghe and granted attendance at court.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he was further enfeoffed as Prince of Qinghe and granted attendance at court.

sentences.zh: 十三年，敕修甲第，遣中使就第賜宴，侑以教坊樂部。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he was ordered to build a mansion; an imperial envoy was sent to his residence to grant a banquet, accompanied by the Directorate of Music.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he was ordered to build a mansion. An imperial envoy was sent to his residence to grant a banquet, accompanied by the Directorate of Music.

sentences.zh: 十六年，改鎮靜江、甯武、靜海軍。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he was transferred to govern the Jingjiang, Ningwu, and Jinghai armies.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year he was transferred to govern the Jingjiang, Ningwu, and Jinghai armies.

sentences.zh: 二十一年冬，帝幸其第，拜太師，以其侄清海軍承宣使子蓋為安德軍節度使，其他子弟遷秩者十三人。

translations.literal: In the winter of the twenty-first year the emperor visited his residence, appointed him Grand Preceptor, made his nephew Zigai, commissioner-in-chief of the Qinghai Army, military governor of the Ande Army, and promoted thirteen other sons and nephews in rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of the twenty-first year the emperor visited his residence and appointed him Grand Preceptor. His nephew Zigai, commissioner-in-chief of the Qinghai Army, was made military governor of the Ande Army, and thirteen other sons and nephews were promoted in rank.

sentences.zh: 南渡後，俊握兵最早，屢立戰功，與韓世忠、劉錡、岳飛並為名將，世稱張、韓、劉、岳。

translations.literal: After the southward crossing, Jun held troops earliest and repeatedly achieved battle merit; with Han Shizhong, Liu Qi, and Yue Fei he was counted among the famous generals, and the age called them Zhang, Han, Liu, and Yue.
translations.idiomatic: After the southward crossing, Jun held troops earliest and repeatedly won distinction in battle. With Han Shizhong, Liu Qi, and Yue Fei he was counted among the famous generals, and the age called them Zhang, Han, Liu, and Yue.

sentences.zh: 然濠、壽之役，俊與錡有隙，獨以楊沂中為腹心，故有濠梁之劫。

translations.literal: Yet in the Hao-Shou campaign Jun had a rift with Qi and relied on Yang Yizhong alone as his trusted confidant; hence the disaster at Haoliang.
translations.idiomatic: Yet in the Hao-Shou campaign Jun had a rift with Qi and relied on Yang Yizhong alone as his trusted confidant; hence the disaster at Haoliang.

sentences.zh: 岳飛冤獄，韓世忠救之，俊獨助檜成其事，心術之殊也，遠哉！

translations.literal: In Yue Fei's unjust case Han Shizhong tried to save him, but Jun alone helped Hui bring it about—the difference in their hearts is vast indeed!
translations.idiomatic: In Yue Fei's unjust case Han Shizhong tried to save him, but Jun alone helped Hui bring it about—the difference in their hearts is vast indeed!

sentences.zh: 帝于諸將中眷俊特厚，然警敕之者不絕口。

translations.literal: Among the generals the emperor favored Jun especially, yet admonitions to him never ceased.
translations.idiomatic: Among the generals the emperor favored Jun especially, yet admonitions to him never ceased.

sentences.zh: 自淮西入見，則教其讀《郭子儀傳》；

translations.literal: When he came from Huai West for an audience, he was taught to read the Biography of Guo Ziyi;
translations.idiomatic: When he came from Huai West for an audience, he was told to read the Biography of Guo Ziyi;

sentences.zh: 召入禁中，戒以毋與民爭利，毋興土木。

translations.literal: summoned into the palace, he was warned not to contend with the people for profit and not to undertake construction projects.
translations.idiomatic: summoned into the palace, he was warned not to contend with the people for profit and not to undertake construction projects.

sentences.zh: 二十四年六月薨，年六十九。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the twenty-fourth year he died at sixty-nine.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the twenty-fourth year he died at sixty-nine.

sentences.zh: 輟視朝三日，斂以一品服，帝臨奠哭之慟。

translations.literal: Court audiences were suspended for three days; he was enshrouded in first-rank robes, and the emperor came in person to offer sacrifice and wept in deep grief.
translations.idiomatic: Court audiences were suspended for three days. He was enshrouded in first-rank robes, and the emperor came in person to offer sacrifice and wept in deep grief.

sentences.zh: 追封循王。

translations.literal: Posthumously he was enfeoffed as Prince of Xun.
translations.idiomatic: Posthumously he was enfeoffed as Prince of Xun.

sentences.zh: 子五人：子琦、子厚、子顏、子正、子仁。

translations.literal: He had five sons: Ziqi, Zihou, Ziyan, Zizheng, and Ziren.
translations.idiomatic: He had five sons: Ziqi, Zihou, Ziyan, Zizheng, and Ziren.

sentences.zh: 從子

translations.literal: Nephew
translations.idiomatic: Nephew

sentences.zh: 子蓋字德高。

translations.literal: Zigai, styled Degao.
translations.idiomatic: Zigai, styled Degao.

sentences.zh: 父宏，應募從俊軍河上。

translations.literal: His father Hong volunteered and followed Jun's army on the river.
translations.idiomatic: His father Hong volunteered and followed Jun's army on the river.

sentences.zh: 金人破開德府，宏戰死。

translations.literal: When the Jurchens took Kaide Prefecture, Hong died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: When the Jurchens took Kaide Prefecture, Hong died in battle.

sentences.zh: 子蓋初從韓世忠討苗傅，補承信郎，累功遷武功郎。

translations.literal: Zigai at first followed Han Shizhong in suppressing Miao Fu, was appointed Chengxin Lang, and for accumulated merit was transferred to Wugong Lang.
translations.idiomatic: Zigai at first followed Han Shizhong in suppressing Miao Fu, was appointed Gentleman for Upholding Trust, and for accumulated merit was transferred to Gentleman of Martial Achievement.

sentences.zh: 紹興六年，劉猊大舉入寇，過定遠縣，將趨宣化窺淮，詔遣俊會劉光世軍剿之。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Shaoxing Liu Ya invaded on a large scale, passed Dingyuan County, and was about to press toward Xuanhua to spy on the Huai; an edict ordered Jun to join Liu Guangshi's army to suppress him.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Shaoxing Liu Ya invaded on a large scale, passed Dingyuan County, and was about to press toward Xuanhua to spy on the Huai. An edict ordered Jun to join Liu Guangshi's army to suppress him.

sentences.zh: 子蓋從俊擊猊於藕塘，授閣門宣贊舍人。

translations.literal: Zigai followed Jun in striking Ya at Outang and was appointed Gatehouse Proclamation Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: Zigai followed Jun in striking Ya at Outang and was appointed Gatehouse Proclamation Attendant.

sentences.zh: 明年，改昌州刺史、江南東路馬步軍都總管。

translations.literal: The next year he was made prefect of Changzhou and overall commander of horse and foot of eastern Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he was made prefect of Changzhou and overall commander of horse and foot of eastern Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 十年，金人再取河南，以興復宿、亳功，遷登州防禦使兼宣撫司衙兵副統制。

translations.literal: In the tenth year the Jurchens again took Henan; for merit in recovering Su and Bo he was transferred to defender of Deng Prefecture and concurrently deputy overall controller of the pacification commission's guard troops.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year the Jurchens again took Henan. For merit in recovering Su and Bo he was transferred to defender of Deng Prefecture and concurrently deputy overall controller of the pacification commission's guard troops.

sentences.zh: 十一年二月，兀朮入廬州，攻含山縣，漸攻曆陽。

translations.literal: In the second month of the eleventh year Wuzhu entered Luzhou, attacked Hanshan County, and gradually pressed Liyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the eleventh year Wuzhu entered Luzhou, attacked Hanshan County, and gradually pressed Liyang.

sentences.zh: 俊遣兵渡江，子蓋從王德馳入和州，金人退屯昭關。

translations.literal: Jun sent troops across the river; Zigai followed Wang De in a dash into Hezhou, and the Jurchens withdrew to encamp at Zhaoguan.
translations.idiomatic: Jun sent troops across the river. Zigai followed Wang De in a dash into Hezhou, and the Jurchens withdrew to Zhaoguan.

sentences.zh: 會劉錡自東關引兵出清溪邀擊金人，俊遣子蓋與錡會，大戰於柘皋，敗之，軍勢赫張。

translations.literal: When Liu Qi led troops from Dongguan out through Qingxi to intercept the Jurchens, Jun sent Zigai to join Qi; they fought a great battle at Zhegao, defeated the enemy, and the army's momentum blazed.
translations.idiomatic: When Liu Qi led troops from Dongguan out through Qingxi to intercept the Jurchens, Jun sent Zigai to join Qi. They fought a great battle at Zhegao, defeated the enemy, and the army's momentum blazed.

sentences.zh: 兀朮復攻濠州，子蓋又敗之于周梁橋，除興甯軍承宣使。

translations.literal: Wuzhu again attacked Haozhou; Zigai again defeated him at Zhouliang Bridge and was appointed commissioner-in-chief of the Xingning Army.
translations.idiomatic: When Wuzhu again attacked Haozhou, Zigai again defeated him at Zhouliang Bridge and was appointed commissioner-in-chief of the Xingning Army.

sentences.zh: 和議成，改建康府駐劄御前諸軍都統制。

translations.literal: When the peace agreement was concluded, he was made overall commander of the imperial armies stationed at Jiankang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: When the peace agreement was concluded, he was made overall commander of the imperial armies stationed at Jiankang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 十三年，授龍神衛四廂都指揮使、兩浙西路馬步軍都總管。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he was appointed overall commander of the four divisions of the Dragon and Divine Guard Armies and overall commander of horse and foot of western Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he was appointed overall commander of the four divisions of the Dragon and Divine Guard Armies and overall commander of horse and foot of western Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 帝幸俊第，授子蓋安德軍節度使。

translations.literal: When the emperor visited Jun's residence, Zigai was appointed military governor of the Ande Army.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor visited Jun's residence, Zigai was appointed military governor of the Ande Army.

sentences.zh: 三十二年春，金人攻海州急，以子蓋為鎮江府都統往援之，即日渡江，馳至楚州。

translations.literal: In the spring of the thirty-second year the Jurchens urgently attacked Haizhou; Zigai was made overall commander of Zhenjiang Prefecture to go to the relief, crossed the river the same day, and galloped to Chuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the thirty-second year the Jurchens urgently attacked Haizhou. Zigai was made overall commander of Zhenjiang Prefecture to go to the relief, crossed the river the same day, and galloped to Chuzhou.

sentences.zh: 淮東漕臣龔濤謂之曰：「敵眾十倍，兵力不支，宜張虛聲攻淮陽，使之必救，則海州可解。」

translations.literal: Gong Tao, transport commissioner of eastern Huai, said to him: 'The enemy outnumber you ten to one; your force cannot hold out. You should feign an attack on Huaiyang so they must rescue it, and then Haizhou can be relieved.'
translations.idiomatic: Gong Tao, transport commissioner of eastern Huai, said to him, 'The enemy outnumber you ten to one and your force cannot hold out. Feign an attack on Huaiyang so they must rescue it, and Haizhou can be relieved.'

sentences.zh: 子蓋曰：「彼若不救，將如之何？」

translations.literal: Zigai said: 'If they do not rescue it, what then?'
translations.idiomatic: Zigai said, 'If they do not rescue it, what then?'

sentences.zh: 乃亟趨漣水，取便道以進。

translations.literal: He then hurried to Lianshui and advanced by a convenient route.
translations.idiomatic: He then hurried to Lianshui and advanced by a convenient route.

sentences.zh: 次石湫堰，金人陳萬騎於河東，子蓋率精銳數千騎擊之，謂麾下曰：「彼眾我寡，利在速戰。」

translations.literal: Encamping at Shiqiu Weir, the Jurchens arrayed ten thousand horsemen east of the river; Zigai led several thousand picked horsemen to attack and told his subordinates: 'They are many and we are few; the advantage lies in swift battle.'
translations.idiomatic: Encamping at Shiqiu Weir, he found the Jurchens arrayed ten thousand horsemen east of the river. Zigai led several thousand picked horsemen to attack and told his subordinates, 'They are many and we are few; the advantage lies in swift battle.'

sentences.zh: 遣統制張玘略陣，玘中流矢，子蓋曰：「事急矣！」

translations.literal: He sent overall controller Zhang Qi to probe the formation; Qi was struck by a flying arrow, and Zigai said: 'The situation is urgent!'
translations.idiomatic: He sent overall controller Zhang Qi to probe the formation. Qi was struck by a flying arrow, and Zigai cried, 'The situation is urgent!'

sentences.zh: 奮臂大呼，馳入陣，諸將繼之殊死戰。

translations.literal: He flung up his arm and shouted, galloped into the formation, and the generals followed in desperate battle.
translations.idiomatic: He flung up his arm and shouted, galloped into the formation, and the generals followed in desperate battle.

sentences.zh: 賊大敗，擁溺石湫河死者半，圍遂解。

translations.literal: The bandits were utterly defeated; half drowned crowding into the Shiqiu River, and the siege was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: The bandits were utterly defeated. Half drowned crowding into the Shiqiu River, and the siege was lifted.

sentences.zh: 金人復整軍來戰，子蓋再率精銳擊之，獲其車馬、鎧仗萬計，退屯泗州。

translations.literal: The Jurchens regrouped and came to fight again; Zigai again led picked troops to strike them, captured their chariots, horses, and armor by the tens of thousands, and withdrew to encamp at Sizhou.
translations.idiomatic: The Jurchens regrouped and came to fight again. Zigai again led picked troops to strike them, captured their chariots, horses, and armor by the tens of thousands, and withdrew to encamp at Sizhou.

sentences.zh: 孝宗即位，召對，賜鞍馬、鎧甲、束帶，且令招集勇敢，相時而動。

translations.literal: When Xiaozong ascended the throne, Zigai was summoned for audience, granted saddle, horse, armor, and belt, and ordered to recruit the brave and act as occasion demanded.
translations.idiomatic: When Xiaozong ascended the throne, Zigai was summoned for audience, granted saddle, horse, armor, and belt, and ordered to recruit the brave and act as occasion demanded.

sentences.zh: 子蓋受命還，招金大將蕭鷓巴、耶律造哩將其眾來降。

translations.literal: Zigai returned upon receiving the order and recruited the Jurchen generals Xiao Zhaba and Yelü Zaoli, who led their followers to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Zigai returned upon receiving the order and recruited the Jurchen generals Xiao Zhaba and Yelü Zaoli, who led their followers to surrender.

sentences.zh: 尋以疾還鎮江，授檢校少保、淮東招撫使，未上，卒，年五十一。

translations.literal: Soon afterward, ill, he returned to Zhenjiang, was appointed honorary junior guardian and Huaidong pacification commissioner, but before taking office died at fifty-one.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward, ill, he returned to Zhenjiang and was appointed honorary junior guardian and Huaidong pacification commissioner, but before taking office he died at fifty-one.

sentences.zh: 贈太尉，諡恭壯。

translations.literal: Posthumously he was made Grand Marshal with the posthumous title Gongzhuang.
translations.idiomatic: Posthumously he was made Grand Marshal with the posthumous title Gongzhuang.

sentences.zh: 子蓋從俊征討藕塘、柘皋，雖多奏功，未能出諸將右，惟海州一捷可稱云。

translations.literal: Zigai followed Jun in campaigns at Outang and Zhegao; though he reported many achievements, he could not surpass the other generals—only the victory at Haizhou is truly worth praise.
translations.idiomatic: Zigai followed Jun in campaigns at Outang and Zhegao. Though he reported many achievements, he could not surpass the other generals—only the victory at Haizhou is truly worth praise.

sentences.zh: 張宗顏

translations.literal: Zhang Zongyan
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zongyan

sentences.zh: 張宗顏，字希賢，延安人。

translations.literal: Zhang Zongyan, styled Xixian, was a native of Yan'an.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zongyan, styled Xixian, came from Yan'an.

sentences.zh: 父吉，為涇原將，解宣威城圍，死之。

translations.literal: His father Ji was a Jingyuan general who relieved the siege of Xuanwei city and died in the effort.
translations.idiomatic: His father Ji was a Jingyuan general who relieved the siege of Xuanwei city and died in the effort.

sentences.zh: 宗顏以父恩補三班借職，監閿鄉酒稅，積官至涇原副將、權殿前司統轄。

translations.literal: Zongyan, through his father's grace, was appointed provisional third-rank attendant, supervised the wine tax of Min Township, and by accumulated rank reached Jingyuan deputy general and acting overall controller of the Palace Front Office.
translations.idiomatic: Zongyan, through his father's grace, was appointed provisional third-rank attendant, supervised the wine tax of Min Township, and by accumulated rank reached Jingyuan deputy general and acting overall controller of the Palace Front Office.

sentences.zh: 禦營軍統制張俊選為統領，從俊討浙西寇。

translations.literal: Imperial Camp Army overall controller Zhang Jun selected him as commander and followed Jun in suppressing bandits in western Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial Camp Army overall controller Zhang Jun selected him as commander and followed Jun in suppressing bandits in western Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 秀州軍校徐明以城叛，宗顏夜襲其城，明遁。

translations.literal: Xiuzhou military officer Xu Ming rebelled with the city; Zongyan raided the city by night and Ming fled.
translations.idiomatic: When Xiuzhou military officer Xu Ming rebelled with the city, Zongyan raided it by night and Ming fled.

sentences.zh: 轉忠州刺史，遷御前中軍統制。

translations.literal: He was transferred to prefect of Zhongzhou and promoted to overall controller of the imperial middle army.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to prefect of Zhongzhou and promoted to overall controller of the imperial middle army.

sentences.zh: 金人攻明州，宗顏破其前軍。

translations.literal: When the Jurchens attacked Mingzhou, Zongyan broke their vanguard.
translations.idiomatic: When the Jurchens attacked Mingzhou, Zongyan broke their vanguard.

sentences.zh: 盜楊勍破松溪，命宗顏及李捧、陳思恭討之。

translations.literal: The bandit Yang Qiong broke Songxi; Zongyan with Li Peng and Chen Sigong were ordered to suppress him.
translations.idiomatic: When the bandit Yang Qiong broke Songxi, Zongyan with Li Peng and Chen Sigong were ordered to suppress him.

sentences.zh: 宗顏次浦城不進，勍又掠建州。

translations.literal: Zongyan halted at Pucheng without advancing; Qiong again plundered Jian Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Zongyan halted at Pucheng without advancing, and Qiong again plundered Jian Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 宗顏趨南劍州，與勍遇，遂歸。

translations.literal: Zongyan hurried to Nanjian Prefecture, met Qiong, and then returned.
translations.idiomatic: Zongyan hurried to Nanjian Prefecture, met Qiong, and then returned.

sentences.zh: 盜猶未平，謬言已擊退。

translations.literal: The bandits were still not pacified, yet false reports said they had already been driven off.
translations.idiomatic: The bandits were still not pacified, yet false reports claimed they had already been driven off.

sentences.zh: 侍御史沈與求劾宗顏三將並出，不能平數千之潰卒，何以示敵。

translations.literal: Remonstrance Attendant Shen Yuqiu impeached Zongyan: the three generals all went out yet could not pacify several thousand routed soldiers—how could this show the enemy anything?
translations.idiomatic: Remonstrance Attendant Shen Yuqiu impeached Zongyan: all three generals had gone out yet could not pacify several thousand routed soldiers—what message did that send to the enemy?

sentences.zh: 貶二秩。

translations.literal: He was demoted two ranks.
translations.idiomatic: He was demoted two ranks.

sentences.zh: 從俊討李成，與成將馬進戰玉隆觀，敗之。

translations.literal: Following Jun in suppressing Li Cheng, he fought Cheng's general Ma Jin at Yulong Abbey and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: Following Jun in suppressing Li Cheng, he fought Cheng's general Ma Jin at Yulong Abbey and defeated him.

sentences.zh: 遷環慶路馬步軍副總管、神武右軍統制，改麟州觀察使。

translations.literal: He was transferred to deputy overall commander of horse and foot of the Huanqing Circuit and overall controller of the Shenwu Right Army, and changed to observation commissioner of Lin Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to deputy overall commander of horse and foot of the Huanqing Circuit and overall controller of the Shenwu Right Army, and made observation commissioner of Lin Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 偽齊挾金人攻宣化鎮，俊遣宗顏潛渡江，出其後襲之，不勝。

translations.literal: When the puppet Qi, backed by the Jurchens, attacked Xuanhua garrison, Jun sent Zongyan to cross the river secretly and strike from behind; he did not win.
translations.idiomatic: When the puppet Qi, backed by the Jurchens, attacked Xuanhua garrison, Jun sent Zongyan to cross the river secretly and strike from behind, but he did not win.

sentences.zh: 俊庇之，以捷聞，遂加沂州防禦使。

translations.literal: Jun shielded him and reported a victory; Zongyan was thereupon promoted to defender of Yi Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Jun shielded him and reported a victory, and Zongyan was thereupon promoted to defender of Yi Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 繼以兵襲擊淮北，復遷崇信軍承宣使、宣撫司前軍統制。

translations.literal: Later he led troops to raid north of the Huai and was again transferred to commissioner-in-chief of the Chongxin Army and overall controller of the pacification commission's vanguard.
translations.idiomatic: Later he led troops to raid north of the Huai and was again transferred to commissioner-in-chief of the Chongxin Army and overall controller of the pacification commission's vanguard.

sentences.zh: 偽齊入寇，詔張俊解淮西急。

translations.literal: When the puppet Qi invaded, an edict ordered Zhang Jun to relieve the crisis in Huai West.
translations.idiomatic: When the puppet Qi invaded, an edict ordered Zhang Jun to relieve the crisis in Huai West.

sentences.zh: 督府張浚遣楊沂中與俊合，檄宗顏自泗州為後繼。

translations.literal: Commissioner Zhang Jun sent Yang Yizhong to join Jun, and ordered Zongyan from Sizhou as rear support.
translations.idiomatic: Commissioner Zhang Jun sent Yang Yizhong to join Jun and ordered Zongyan from Sizhou as rear support.

sentences.zh: 與猊遇于李家灣，大破之，橫屍滿野，猊僅以身遁。

translations.literal: They met Ya at Lijiawan and inflicted a great defeat; corpses lay across the field, and Ya barely escaped with his life.
translations.idiomatic: They met Ya at Lijiawan and inflicted a great defeat. Corpses lay across the field, and Ya barely escaped with his life.

sentences.zh: 擢龍神衛四廂都指揮使、武信軍承宣使。

translations.literal: He was promoted to overall commander of the four divisions of the Dragon and Divine Guard Armies and commissioner-in-chief of the Wuxin Army.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to overall commander of the four divisions of the Dragon and Divine Guard Armies and commissioner-in-chief of the Wuxin Army.

sentences.zh: 八年，知廬州，總帥事。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he was prefect of Luzhou and commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he was prefect of Luzhou and commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 敵數百騎抵城下，宗顏以騎百餘禦之，敵退。

translations.literal: Several hundred enemy horsemen reached the foot of the wall; Zongyan with a little more than a hundred horsemen repelled them, and the enemy withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Several hundred enemy horsemen reached the foot of the wall. Zongyan with a little more than a hundred horsemen repelled them, and the enemy withdrew.

sentences.zh: 有至自淮北者，傳金人言曰：「此張鐵山弟也。」

translations.literal: Someone arriving from north of the Huai relayed the Jurchens' words: 'This is Iron Mountain Zhang's younger brother.'
translations.idiomatic: Someone arriving from north of the Huai relayed the Jurchens' words: 'This is Iron Mountain Zhang's younger brother.'

sentences.zh: 紹興九年卒，年四十四。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Shaoxing he died at forty-four.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year of Shaoxing he died at forty-four.

sentences.zh: 贈保靜軍節度使，諡壯敏。

translations.literal: Posthumously he was made military governor of the Baojing Army with the posthumous title Zhuangmin.
translations.idiomatic: Posthumously he was made military governor of the Baojing Army with the posthumous title Zhuangmin.

sentences.zh: 劉光世

translations.literal: Liu Guangshi
translations.idiomatic: Liu Guangshi

sentences.zh: 劉光世，字平叔，保安軍人，延慶次子。

translations.literal: Liu Guangshi, styled Pingshu, was a native of Bao'an Army and the second son of Yanqing.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Guangshi, styled Pingshu, came from Bao'an Army and was the second son of Yanqing.

sentences.zh: 初以蔭補三班奉職，累升鄜延路兵馬都監、蘄州防禦使。

translations.literal: At first through hereditary privilege he was appointed third-rank palace attendant; by accumulated promotion he rose to overall inspector of horse and foot of the Yanyan Circuit and defender of Qiz Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: At first through hereditary privilege he was appointed third-rank palace attendant. By accumulated promotion he rose to overall inspector of horse and foot of the Yanyan Circuit and defender of Qiz Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 方臘反，延慶為宣撫司都統，遣光世自將一軍趨衢、婺，出其不意破之。

translations.literal: When Fang La rebelled, Yanqing was overall commander of the pacification commission and sent Guangshi at the head of one army toward Qu and Wu, breaking them by surprise.
translations.idiomatic: When Fang La rebelled, Yanqing was overall commander of the pacification commission and sent Guangshi at the head of one army toward Qu and Wu, breaking them by surprise.

sentences.zh: 賊平，授耀州觀察使，升鄜延路兵馬鈐轄。

translations.literal: When the bandits were pacified, he was appointed observation commissioner of Yao Prefecture and promoted to overall controller of horse and foot of the Yanyan Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: When the bandits were pacified, he was appointed observation commissioner of Yao Prefecture and promoted to overall controller of horse and foot of the Yanyan Circuit.

sentences.zh: 時有事燕洑，光世從延慶取易州，授奉國軍承宣使。

translations.literal: At that time there was campaigning at Yanfu; Guangshi followed Yanqing in taking Yi Prefecture and was appointed commissioner-in-chief of the Fengguo Army.
translations.idiomatic: At that time there was campaigning at Yanfu. Guangshi followed Yanqing in taking Yi Prefecture and was appointed commissioner-in-chief of the Fengguo Army.

sentences.zh: 金將郭藥師降，除威武、奉甯軍承宣使。

translations.literal: When the Jurchen general Guo Yaoshi surrendered, he was made commissioner-in-chief of the Weiwu and Fengning armies.
translations.idiomatic: When the Jurchen general Guo Yaoshi surrendered, he was made commissioner-in-chief of the Weiwu and Fengning armies.

sentences.zh: 延慶遣諸將搗虛趨燕，以光世為後繼。
