translations.literal: Yanqing sent the generals to strike at an empty point toward Yan; Guangshi was the rear support.
translations.idiomatic: Yanqing sent the generals to strike at an empty point toward Yan while Guangshi served as rear support.

sentences.zh: 光世不至，諸將失援而潰，降三官。

translations.literal: Guangshi did not arrive; the generals lost support and collapsed, and he was demoted three ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Guangshi did not arrive. The generals lost support and collapsed, and he was demoted three ranks.

sentences.zh: 河北賊張迪掠浚州境，詔光世討之。

translations.literal: The Hebei bandit Zhang Di plundered the borders of Jun Prefecture; an edict ordered Guangshi to suppress him.
translations.idiomatic: The Hebei bandit Zhang Di plundered the borders of Jun Prefecture, and an edict ordered Guangshi to suppress him.

sentences.zh: 光世曰：「賊烏合，非有紀律，佯北以邀之，其亂可取也。」

translations.literal: Guangshi said: 'The bandits are a mob without discipline; feign retreat to lure them and their disorder can be seized.'
translations.idiomatic: Guangshi said, 'The bandits are a mob without discipline. Feign retreat to lure them and their disorder can be seized.'

sentences.zh: 即麾騎退。

translations.literal: He immediately ordered the horsemen to withdraw.
translations.idiomatic: He immediately ordered the horsemen to withdraw.

sentences.zh: 賊競進，光世引騎貫其中，賊大潰。

translations.literal: The bandits pressed forward in competition; Guangshi led horsemen through their midst and the bandits collapsed utterly.
translations.idiomatic: The bandits pressed forward eagerly. Guangshi led horsemen through their midst and the bandits collapsed utterly.

sentences.zh: 復承宣使，充鄜延路馬步軍副總管。

translations.literal: He was restored as commissioner-in-chief and appointed deputy overall commander of horse and foot of the Yanyan Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: He was restored as commissioner-in-chief and appointed deputy overall commander of horse and foot of the Yanyan Circuit.

sentences.zh: 靖康元年，金兵攻汴京，夏人乘間寇杏子堡。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jingkang the Jurchen army attacked Bianjing; the Tanguts seized the interval to raid Xingzi Fort.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Jingkang (1126) the Jurchen army attacked Bianjing. The Tanguts seized the opportunity to raid Xingzi Fort.

sentences.zh: 堡有兩山對峙，地險厄，光世據之，敵至敗去。

translations.literal: The fort had two mountains facing each other and terrain perilously narrow; Guangshi held it and the enemy arrived, was defeated, and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: The fort had two mountains facing each other on perilously narrow ground. Guangshi held it, and when the enemy arrived they were defeated and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 擢侍衛馬軍都虞候。

translations.literal: He was promoted to chief adjutant of the palace guard cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to chief adjutant of the palace guard cavalry.

sentences.zh: 金再攻汴京，光世入援，聞范致虛傳檄諸路，議引兵會之。

translations.literal: When the Jurchens again attacked Bianjing, Guangshi entered to relieve it; hearing that Fan Zhixu was issuing proclamations to all routes, he deliberated leading troops to join him.
translations.idiomatic: When the Jurchens again attacked Bianjing, Guangshi entered to relieve the capital. Hearing that Fan Zhixu was issuing proclamations to all routes, he deliberated leading troops to join him.

sentences.zh: 會有詔止勤王兵，光世以為宜速進，不可以詔示眾。

translations.literal: An edict then ordered the relief armies to halt; Guangshi held that they should advance swiftly and that the edict could not be shown to the troops.
translations.idiomatic: An edict then ordered the relief armies to halt. Guangshi held that they should advance swiftly and that the edict could not be shown to the troops.

sentences.zh: 既而潰兵至，具言京城事。

translations.literal: Soon routed soldiers arrived and fully recounted affairs of the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Soon routed soldiers arrived and fully recounted affairs of the capital.

sentences.zh: 眾懼，光世矯以蕃官來自汴京，謂二帝決圍南去，眾稍安，進屯陝府。

translations.literal: The men were afraid; Guangshi falsely claimed that a frontier official had come from Bianjing and said the two emperors had decided to break the encirclement and go south, and the troops were somewhat reassured; he advanced and encamped at Shaanfu.
translations.idiomatic: The men were afraid. Guangshi falsely claimed that a frontier official had come from Bianjing saying the two emperors had decided to break the encirclement and go south, and the troops were somewhat reassured. He advanced and encamped at Shaanfu.

sentences.zh: 致虛欲合五路兵進與金戰，光世難之，別道趨虢，遂至濟州謁康王，命為五軍都提舉。

translations.literal: Zhixu wished to combine the five-route armies to advance and fight the Jurchens; Guangshi found this difficult, took a separate route toward Guo, and thus reached Jizhou to pay homage to Prince Kang, who appointed him overall commander of the Five Armies.
translations.idiomatic: Zhixu wished to combine the five-route armies to advance and fight the Jurchens. Guangshi found this difficult, took a separate route toward Guo, and reached Jizhou to pay homage to Prince Kang, who appointed him overall commander of the Five Armies.

sentences.zh: 王即皇帝位，命為省視陵寢使，尋為提舉禦營使司一行事務、行在都巡檢使。

translations.literal: When the prince ascended the throne, Guangshi was appointed commissioner for inspecting imperial tombs, and soon made commissioner for managing the affairs of the Imperial Camp Commission and chief inspector of the mobile court.
translations.idiomatic: When the prince ascended the throne, Guangshi was appointed commissioner for inspecting imperial tombs, and soon made commissioner for managing the affairs of the Imperial Camp Commission and chief inspector of the mobile court.

sentences.zh: 斬山東賊李昱，遷奉國軍節度使。

translations.literal: He executed the Shandong bandit Li Yu and was transferred to military governor of the Fengguo Army.
translations.idiomatic: He executed the Shandong bandit Li Yu and was transferred to military governor of the Fengguo Army.

sentences.zh: 平鎮江叛兵，改滁濠太平州、無為軍、江寧府制置使。

translations.literal: After pacifying the rebel troops at Zhenjiang, he was made pacification commissioner of Chu, Hao, Taiping Prefecture, Wuwei Army, and Jiangning Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: After pacifying the rebel troops at Zhenjiang, he was made pacification commissioner of Chu, Hao, Taiping Prefecture, Wuwei Army, and Jiangning Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 討張遇于池州，遇望其陣曰：「官軍不整，可破也。」

translations.literal: Suppressing Zhang Yu at Chizhou, Yu looked at his formation and said: 'The government army is not in order; it can be broken.'
translations.idiomatic: Suppressing Zhang Yu at Chizhou, Yu looked at his formation and said, 'The government army is not in order; it can be broken.'

sentences.zh: 時湖水涸，賊越湖出官軍後，官軍亂，光世幾被執，王德救之得免。

translations.literal: At that time the lake waters had dried; the bandits crossed the lake and emerged behind the government army. The army fell into disorder; Guangshi was nearly captured, but Wang De rescued him and he escaped.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the lake waters had dried. The bandits crossed the lake and emerged behind the government army. The army fell into disorder; Guangshi was nearly captured, but Wang De rescued him and he escaped.

sentences.zh: 遇循江而上，光世整兵追至江州，斷其後軍破之。

translations.literal: Yu proceeded upriver; Guangshi reorganized the army and pursued to Jiangzhou, cut off his rear army, and defeated it.
translations.idiomatic: Yu proceeded upriver. Guangshi reorganized the army, pursued to Jiangzhou, cut off his rear army, and defeated it.

sentences.zh: 遇復東下，又追擊于江寧。

translations.literal: Yu again moved east; Guangshi again pursued and fought at Jiangning.
translations.idiomatic: When Yu again moved east, Guangshi again pursued and fought at Jiangning.

sentences.zh: 二年，以功加檢校少保，命討李成。

translations.literal: In the second year, for merit he was promoted to honorary junior guardian and ordered to suppress Li Cheng.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, for merit he was promoted to honorary junior guardian and ordered to suppress Li Cheng.

sentences.zh: 光世以王德為先鋒，與成遇于上蔡驛口橋，敗之。

translations.literal: Guangshi made Wang De vanguard; they met Cheng at Shangcai Yikou Bridge and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: Guangshi made Wang De vanguard. They met Cheng at Shangcai Yikou Bridge and defeated him.

sentences.zh: 成收散卒再戰，光世以儒服臨軍，成遙見白袍青蓋，並兵圍之，德潰圍拔光世以出。

translations.literal: Cheng gathered scattered troops and fought again; Guangshi attended the army in scholar's robes. Cheng saw the white robe and green canopy from afar, combined forces, and encircled him; De broke through the encirclement and pulled Guangshi out.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng gathered scattered troops and fought again. Guangshi attended the army in scholar's robes. Cheng saw the white robe and green canopy from afar, combined forces, and encircled him. De broke through the encirclement and pulled Guangshi out.

sentences.zh: 下令得成者以其官爵與之。

translations.literal: An order was issued that whoever captured Cheng would receive his office and rank.
translations.idiomatic: An order was issued that whoever captured Cheng would receive his office and rank.

sentences.zh: 士爭奮，再戰皆捷，成遁，執其謀主陶子思。

translations.literal: The soldiers vied in ardor; in the second battle all were victorious. Cheng fled, and his strategist Tao Zisi was captured.
translations.idiomatic: The soldiers vied in ardor. In the second battle all were victorious. Cheng fled, and his strategist Tao Zisi was captured.

sentences.zh: 加檢校少傅。

translations.literal: He was promoted to honorary junior mentor.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to honorary junior mentor.

sentences.zh: 帝在揚州，金騎掩至天長，光世迎敵，未至而軍潰。

translations.literal: When the emperor was at Yangzhou, Jurchen horsemen struck suddenly at Tianchang; Guangshi went to meet the enemy but before he arrived the army collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor was at Yangzhou, Jurchen horsemen struck suddenly at Tianchang. Guangshi went to meet the enemy but before he arrived the army collapsed.

sentences.zh: 帝倉卒渡江，命光世為行在五軍制置使，屯鎮江府，控扼江口。

translations.literal: The emperor hastily crossed the river and appointed Guangshi commissioner of the mobile court's five armies, encamped at Zhenjiang Prefecture, and controlling the river mouth.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor hastily crossed the river and appointed Guangshi commissioner of the mobile court's five armies, encamped at Zhenjiang Prefecture to control the river mouth.

sentences.zh: 尋加檢校太保、殿前都指揮使。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was promoted to honorary grand guardian and overall commander of the Palace Front.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he was promoted to honorary grand guardian and overall commander of the Palace Front.

sentences.zh: 苗、劉為亂，素憚光世，遷光世為太尉、淮南制置使。

translations.literal: When Miao and Liu rebelled, they had always feared Guangshi; Guangshi was transferred to Grand Marshal and Huainan pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: When Miao and Liu rebelled, they had always feared Guangshi. He was transferred to Grand Marshal and Huainan pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 張浚在平江，馳書諭以勤王，光世不從；

translations.literal: Zhang Jun was at Pingjiang and sent a fast letter urging him to rush to the emperor's aid; Guangshi did not obey.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jun was at Pingjiang and sent a fast letter urging him to rush to the emperor's aid, but Guangshi did not obey.

sentences.zh: 呂頤浩遣使至鎮江說之，乃引兵會於丹陽。

translations.literal: Lü Yihao sent an envoy to Zhenjiang to persuade him, and he then led troops to join at Danyang.
translations.idiomatic: Lü Yihao sent an envoy to Zhenjiang to persuade him, and he then led troops to join at Danyang.

sentences.zh: 兵進，光世以選卒為遊擊，仍分軍殿后，遇苗翊、馬柔吉軍于臨平，與韓世忠等破之。

translations.literal: As the army advanced, Guangshi used picked troops as skirmishers and still divided forces as rearguard; they met the armies of Miao Yi and Ma Rouji at Linping and, with Han Shizhong and others, defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: As the army advanced, Guangshi used picked troops as skirmishers and still divided forces as rearguard. They met the armies of Miao Yi and Ma Rouji at Linping and, with Han Shizhong and others, defeated them.

sentences.zh: 至行在，遷太尉、禦營副使。

translations.literal: Upon reaching the mobile court, he was transferred to Grand Marshal and deputy commissioner of the Imperial Camp.
translations.idiomatic: Upon reaching the mobile court, he was transferred to Grand Marshal and deputy commissioner of the Imperial Camp.

sentences.zh: 光世遣王德助喬仲福追傅至崇安縣，盡降其眾，傅僅以身免。

translations.literal: Guangshi sent Wang De to help Qiao Zhongfu pursue Fu to Chong'an County, fully accepting the surrender of his followers; Fu barely escaped with his life.
translations.idiomatic: Guangshi sent Wang De to help Qiao Zhongfu pursue Fu to Chong'an County and fully accepted the surrender of his followers. Fu barely escaped with his life.

sentences.zh: 逆將範瓊被執，張浚使光世撫定其眾，又招賊靳賽降之。

translations.literal: The rebel general Fan Qiong was captured; Zhang Jun had Guangshi pacify his followers and also recruited the bandit Jin Sai to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: The rebel general Fan Qiong was captured. Zhang Jun had Guangshi pacify his followers and also recruited the bandit Jin Sai to surrender.

sentences.zh: 命光世為江東宣撫使，守太平及池州，受杜充節制。

translations.literal: Guangshi was appointed Jiangdong pacification commissioner, holding Taiping and Chizhou, under Du Chong's command.
translations.idiomatic: Guangshi was appointed Jiangdong pacification commissioner, holding Taiping and Chizhou, under Du Chong's command.

sentences.zh: 光世言受充節制有不可者六，帝怒，詔毋入光世殿門，光世始受命。

translations.literal: Guangshi said there were six reasons why accepting Chong's command was impossible; the emperor was angry and ordered that Guangshi not enter the palace gates. Guangshi then accepted the order.
translations.idiomatic: Guangshi said there were six reasons why accepting Chong's command was impossible. The emperor was angry and ordered that Guangshi not enter the palace gates. Guangshi then accepted the order.

sentences.zh: 隆祐太后在南昌，議者謂金人自蘄、黃渡江，陸行二百里可至，命光世移屯江州為遮罩。

translations.literal: Empress Dowager Longyou was at Nanchang; counsellors said that if the Jurchens crossed the river from Qi and Huang, two hundred li overland would reach her; Guangshi was ordered to move encampment to Jiangzhou as a screen.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Dowager Longyou was at Nanchang. Counsellors said that if the Jurchens crossed the river from Qi and Huang, two hundred li overland would reach her. Guangshi was ordered to move encampment to Jiangzhou as a screen.

sentences.zh: 光世既至，日置酒高會。

translations.literal: Once Guangshi arrived, he held wine feasts every day.
translations.idiomatic: Once Guangshi arrived, he held wine feasts every day.

sentences.zh: 金人自黃州渡江，凡三日，無知之者。

translations.literal: The Jurchens crossed the river from Huang Prefecture; for three days no one knew.
translations.idiomatic: The Jurchens crossed the river from Huang Prefecture, and for three days no one knew.

sentences.zh: 比金人至，遂遁，太后退保虔州。

translations.literal: By the time the Jurchens arrived, he fled; the empress dowager withdrew to protect Gan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: By the time the Jurchens arrived, he fled, and the empress dowager withdrew to protect Gan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 馮楫貽書光世，言：「賊深入，最兵家之忌。

translations.literal: Feng Ji sent Guangshi a letter saying: 'Deep penetration by bandits is what military strategists most dread.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Ji sent Guangshi a letter saying, 'Deep penetration by bandits is what military strategists most dread.

sentences.zh: 進則距山，退則背江，百無一利，而敢如此橫行者，以前無抗拒，後無襲逐也。

translations.literal: Advancing, they face mountains; retreating, they have the river at their backs—nothing to their advantage—yet they dare act so boldly because there is no resistance ahead and no pursuit from behind.
translations.idiomatic: Advancing, they face mountains; retreating, they have the river at their backs—nothing to their advantage—yet they dare act so boldly because there is no resistance ahead and no pursuit from behind.

sentences.zh: 太尉儻選精兵自將來洪，而開一路令歸，伏兵掩之，可使匹馬不還。」

translations.literal: If the Grand Marshal would select picked troops and come in person to Hong, while opening a route for them to return and setting an ambush, not a single horse need return.'
translations.idiomatic: If the Grand Marshal would select picked troops and come in person to Hong, while opening a route for them to return and setting an ambush, not a single horse need return.'

sentences.zh: 光世不能用，自信州引兵至南康。

translations.literal: Guangshi could not use the plan and led troops from Xin Prefecture to Nankang.
translations.idiomatic: Guangshi could not use the plan and led troops from Xin Prefecture to Nankang.

sentences.zh: 酈瓊圍固始縣，光世遣人招降之，又遣王德擒妖賊王念經於信州。

translations.literal: Li Qiong besieged Gushi County; Guangshi sent men to recruit him to surrender and also sent Wang De to capture the sorcerer-bandit Wang Nianjing at Xin Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Li Qiong besieged Gushi County. Guangshi sent men to recruit him to surrender and also sent Wang De to capture the sorcerer-bandit Wang Nianjing at Xin Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 時光世部曲無所隸，號「太尉兵」，侍御史沈與求論其非宜。

translations.literal: At that time Guangshi's followers belonged to no command and were called 'Grand Marshal's troops'; Remonstrance Attendant Shen Yuqiu argued this was improper.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Guangshi's followers belonged to no command and were called "Grand Marshal's troops." Remonstrance Attendant Shen Yuqiu argued this was improper.

sentences.zh: 會禦營司廢，乃以「巡衛」名其軍，命充御前巡衛軍都統制。

translations.literal: When the Imperial Camp Commission was abolished, his army was named 'Patrol Guard' and he was appointed overall commander of the imperial Patrol Guard Army.
translations.idiomatic: When the Imperial Camp Commission was abolished, his army was named "Patrol Guard" and he was appointed overall commander of the imperial Patrol Guard Army.

sentences.zh: 召赴行在，授浙西安撫大使、知鎮江府。

translations.literal: He was summoned to the mobile court and appointed grand pacification commissioner of western Zhejiang and prefect of Zhenjiang.
translations.idiomatic: He was summoned to the mobile court and appointed grand pacification commissioner of western Zhejiang and prefect of Zhenjiang.

sentences.zh: 光世言：「安撫控制一路，若但守鎮江，則他郡有警，不可離任。

translations.literal: Guangshi said: 'The pacification commissioner controls a whole circuit; if he only holds Zhenjiang, then when other prefectures are alarmed he cannot leave his post.
translations.idiomatic: Guangshi said, 'The pacification commissioner controls a whole circuit. If he only holds Zhenjiang, then when other prefectures are alarmed he cannot leave his post.

sentences.zh: 望別除守臣，光世專充安撫使，從便置司。」

translations.literal: I hope another defender may be separately appointed so that Guangshi may serve solely as pacification commissioner and establish headquarters where convenient.'
translations.idiomatic: I hope another defender may be separately appointed so that I may serve solely as pacification commissioner and establish headquarters where convenient.'

sentences.zh: 時光世慮金人必過江，故預擇便地，帝覺之，止許增辟通判。

translations.literal: At that time Guangshi feared the Jurchens would surely cross the river and therefore chose a convenient place in advance; the emperor perceived this and only allowed adding an additional vice prefect.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Guangshi feared the Jurchens would surely cross the river and therefore chose a convenient place in advance. The emperor perceived this and only allowed adding an additional vice prefect.

sentences.zh: 右諫議大夫黎確疏其擇便求佚，中外所憤，帝釋不問，加甯武軍節度使、開府儀同三司以遣之。

translations.literal: Right Remonstrance Grandee Li Que memorialized that he was choosing convenience and seeking ease, which angered court and country; the emperor released him without inquiry, added him as military governor of the Ningwu Army and Commissioner with the Same Rank as the Three Excellencies, and sent him off.
translations.idiomatic: Right Remonstrance Grandee Li Que memorialized that he was choosing convenience and seeking ease, which angered court and country. The emperor released him without inquiry, added him as military governor of the Ningwu Army and Commissioner with the Same Rank as the Three Excellencies, and sent him off.

sentences.zh: 光世乞便宜行事，不許。

translations.literal: Guangshi requested discretionary authority; it was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: Guangshi requested discretionary authority; it was not granted.

sentences.zh: 時韓世忠、張俊兼領浙西制置使，光世復言本路兵火之余，不任三處需求，遂罷世忠、俊兼領。

translations.literal: At that time Han Shizhong and Zhang Jun concurrently held the western Zhejiang pacification commission; Guangshi again said that after the fires of war this circuit could not meet three demands, and their concurrent posts were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Han Shizhong and Zhang Jun concurrently held the western Zhejiang pacification commission. Guangshi again said that after the fires of war this circuit could not meet three demands, and their concurrent posts were abolished.

sentences.zh: 時金兵留淮東，光世頗畏其鋒，楚州被圍已百日，帝手劄趣光世援楚者五，竟不行；

translations.literal: At that time Jurchen troops remained in eastern Huai; Guangshi was quite afraid of their edge. Chuzhou had been besieged for a hundred days; the emperor sent five personal letters urging Guangshi to relieve Chuzhou, yet he did not go.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Jurchen troops remained in eastern Huai and Guangshi was quite afraid of their edge. Chuzhou had been besieged for a hundred days. The emperor sent five personal letters urging Guangshi to relieve it, yet he did not go.

sentences.zh: 但遣王德、酈瓊將輕兵以出，時奏殺獲而已。

translations.literal: He only sent Wang De and Li Qiong with light troops to go out and from time to time memorialized kills and captures.
translations.idiomatic: He only sent Wang De and Li Qiong with light troops to go out and from time to time memorialized kills and captures.

sentences.zh: 楚州破，命光世節制諸鎮，力守通、泰。

translations.literal: When Chuzhou fell, Guangshi was ordered to command the garrisons and hold Tong and Tai with all his strength.
translations.idiomatic: When Chuzhou fell, Guangshi was ordered to command the garrisons and hold Tong and Tai with all his strength.

sentences.zh: 完顏昌屯承、楚，光世知其眾思歸，欲攜貳之。

translations.literal: Wanyan Chang encamped at Cheng and Chu; Guangshi knew his troops wished to return and wanted to win them over.
translations.idiomatic: Wanyan Chang encamped at Cheng and Chu. Guangshi knew his troops wished to return and wanted to win them over.

sentences.zh: 乃鑄金銀銅錢，文曰「招納信寶」。

translations.literal: He cast gold, silver, and copper coins inscribed 'Recruitment Trust Token.'
translations.idiomatic: He cast gold, silver, and copper coins inscribed "Recruitment Trust Token."

sentences.zh: 獲敵不殺，令持錢文示其徒，有欲歸者，扣江執錢為信。

translations.literal: Captured enemies were not killed; they were told to show the coin inscription to their followers, and those who wished to return knocked on the riverbank holding the coin as token.
translations.idiomatic: Captured enemies were not killed. They were told to show the coin inscription to their followers, and those who wished to return knocked on the riverbank holding the coin as token.

sentences.zh: 歸者不絕，因創「奇兵」、「赤心」兩軍，昌遂拔砦去。

translations.literal: Surrenders never ceased; he therefore created the 'Odd Troops' and 'Red Heart' armies, and Chang thereupon broke camp and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Surrenders never ceased. He therefore created the "Odd Troops" and "Red Heart" armies, and Chang thereupon broke camp and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 紹興元年，金人渡淮，真、揚州皆闕守，命光世兼淮南、京東路宣撫使，置司揚州，措置屯田，迄不行。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shaoxing the Jurchens crossed the Huai; Zhen and Yang Prefectures both lacked defenders. Guangshi was ordered concurrently as pacification commissioner of Huainan and Jingdong circuits, to establish headquarters at Yangzhou and arrange garrison farming, but this was never carried out.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Shaoxing the Jurchens crossed the Huai. Zhen and Yang Prefectures both lacked defenders. Guangshi was ordered concurrently as pacification commissioner of Huainan and Jingdong circuits, to establish headquarters at Yangzhou and arrange garrison farming, but this was never carried out.

sentences.zh: 張俊討李成，又命光世分兵往舒、蘄搗其巢穴，光世以江北盜未平為辭。

translations.literal: Zhang Jun was suppressing Li Cheng; Guangshi was again ordered to divide troops and strike toward Shu and Qi to raid his nest, but Guangshi pleaded that bandits north of the river were not yet pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jun was suppressing Li Cheng. Guangshi was again ordered to divide troops toward Shu and Qi to raid his nest, but Guangshi pleaded that bandits north of the river were not yet pacified.

sentences.zh: 命兼淮南宣撫使，領真、揚、通、承、楚州、漣水軍。

translations.literal: He was ordered concurrently as Huainan pacification commissioner, overseeing Zhen, Yang, Tong, Cheng, Chu Prefecture, and Lianshui Army.
translations.idiomatic: He was ordered concurrently as Huainan pacification commissioner, overseeing Zhen, Yang, Tong, Cheng, Chu Prefecture, and Lianshui Army.

sentences.zh: 郭仲威謀據淮南以通劉豫，光世遣王德擒之，並其眾。

translations.literal: Guo Zhongwei plotted to hold Huainan to communicate with Liu Yu; Guangshi sent Wang De to capture him and absorb his followers.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Zhongwei plotted to hold Huainan to communicate with Liu Yu. Guangshi sent Wang De to capture him and absorb his followers.

sentences.zh: 范宗尹言：「光世軍多冗費，請汰其罷軟者。」

translations.literal: Fan Zongyin said: "Guangshi's army has much wasteful expense; please weed out the slack and weak."
translations.idiomatic: Fan Zongyin said, "Guangshi's army has much wasteful expense. Please weed out the slack and weak."

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「俟作手書與之，如家人禮，庶幾不疑。」

translations.literal: The emperor said: "Wait until I write him a letter in my own hand, as among family, so he will hardly doubt."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "Wait until I write him a letter in my own hand, as among family, so he will hardly doubt."

sentences.zh: 光世以枯秸生穗為瑞，聞於朝。

translations.literal: Guangshi reported as an auspice that withered stalks had sprouted grain ears and informed the court.
translations.idiomatic: Guangshi reported as an auspice that withered stalks had sprouted grain ears and informed the court.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「歲豐人不乏食，朝得賢輔佐，軍有十萬鐵騎，乃可為瑞，此外不足信。」

translations.literal: The emperor said: 'Only when harvests are abundant and people lack no food, the court has worthy assistants, and the army has a hundred thousand iron cavalry can there be an auspice; apart from this it is not to be believed.'
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, 'Only when harvests are abundant and people lack no food, the court has worthy assistants, and the army has a hundred thousand iron cavalry can there be an auspice. Apart from this it is not to be believed.'

sentences.zh: 淮北人多歸附者，命光世兼海、泗宣撫使以安輯之。

translations.literal: Many people north of the Huai were returning to allegiance; Guangshi was ordered concurrently as Hai and Si pacification commissioner to settle them.
translations.idiomatic: Many people north of the Huai were returning to allegiance. Guangshi was ordered concurrently as Hai and Si pacification commissioner to settle them.

sentences.zh: 五湖捕魚人夏寧聚眾千余，掠人為食，郭仲威餘黨出沒淮南，邵青據通州，光世皆招降之。

translations.literal: Xia Ning, a fisherman of the Five Lakes, gathered more than a thousand men and plundered people for food; Guo Zhongwei's remaining followers roamed eastern Huai, and Shao Qing held Tong Prefecture—all were recruited to surrender by Guangshi.
translations.idiomatic: Xia Ning, a fisherman of the Five Lakes, gathered more than a thousand men and plundered people for food. Guo Zhongwei's remaining followers roamed eastern Huai, and Shao Qing held Tong Prefecture—all were recruited to surrender by Guangshi.

sentences.zh: 光世請鑄淮東宣撫使印，給錢糧，增將吏，皆從其請。

translations.literal: Guangshi requested casting a Huaidong pacification commission seal, supplying funds and grain, and increasing officers; all were granted.
translations.idiomatic: Guangshi requested casting a Huaidong pacification commission seal, supplying funds and grain, and increasing officers; all were granted.

sentences.zh: 仍給鎮江府、常州、江陰軍苗米三十七萬斛，為軍中一歲費。

translations.literal: He was also granted 370,000 hu of seed grain from Zhenjiang Prefecture, Chang Prefecture, and Jiangyin Army as one year's military expense.
translations.idiomatic: He was also granted 370,000 hu of seed grain from Zhenjiang Prefecture, Chang Prefecture, and Jiangyin Army as one year's military expense.

sentences.zh: 二年，復命移屯揚州，時至鎮江視師。

translations.literal: In the second year he was again ordered to move encampment to Yangzhou and at the time came to Zhenjiang to inspect the army.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he was again ordered to move encampment to Yangzhou and at the time came to Zhenjiang to inspect the army.

sentences.zh: 光世不奉詔，入朝言：鄰寇有疑，或致生事，願仍領浙西為根本計。

translations.literal: Guangshi did not obey the edict and entered court, saying neighboring bandits were suspicious and might cause trouble; he wished still to hold western Zhejiang as a foundation.
translations.idiomatic: Guangshi did not obey the edict and entered court, saying neighboring bandits were suspicious and might cause trouble. He wished still to hold western Zhejiang as a foundation.

sentences.zh: 右司諫方孟卿劾之，乞召宰執與議，使之必往，光世猶以乏糧為辭。

translations.literal: Right Secretariat Remonstrance Fang Mengqing impeached him, asking that the chief ministers be summoned to discuss and compel him to go; Guangshi still pleaded lack of grain.
translations.idiomatic: Right Secretariat Remonstrance Fang Mengqing impeached him, asking that the chief ministers be summoned to discuss and compel him to go. Guangshi still pleaded lack of grain.

sentences.zh: 光世之來，以繒帛、方物為獻，帝命分賜六宮，中丞沈與求以為不可，命還之。

translations.literal: When Guangshi came, he presented silk and local products as gifts; the emperor ordered them divided among the six palaces. Censor-in-Chief Shen Yuqiu thought this improper and they were ordered returned.
translations.idiomatic: When Guangshi came, he presented silk and local products as gifts. The emperor ordered them divided among the six palaces, but Censor-in-Chief Shen Yuqiu thought this improper and they were ordered returned.

sentences.zh: 呂頤浩與光世有故怨，頤浩將出視師，首言光世兵冗不練，乞移其軍還闕。

translations.literal: Lü Yihao had an old grievance with Guangshi; when Yihao was about to go out to inspect the army, he first said Guangshi's troops were redundant and untrained and asked to move his army back to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Lü Yihao had an old grievance with Guangshi. When Yihao was about to go out to inspect the army, he first said Guangshi's troops were redundant and untrained and asked to move his army back to the capital.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「光世軍糧不足，若驟移，必潰，先犒軍而後料簡可也。」

translations.literal: The emperor said: 'Guangshi's army lacks grain; if moved suddenly it will surely collapse. First reward the army and then sort them out—that will do.'
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, 'Guangshi's army lacks grain. If moved suddenly it will surely collapse. First reward the army and then sort them out—that will do.'

sentences.zh: 頤浩至鎮江，光世軍果告乏，頤浩奏光世軍月費二千萬緡，乞差官考核。

translations.literal: When Yihao reached Zhenjiang, Guangshi's army indeed reported shortage; Yihao memorialized that Guangshi's army cost twenty million strings per month and asked that officials be sent to audit.
translations.idiomatic: When Yihao reached Zhenjiang, Guangshi's army indeed reported shortage. Yihao memorialized that Guangshi's army cost twenty million strings per month and asked that officials be sent to audit.

sentences.zh: 詔御史江躋、度支胡蒙至軍點校，終不得實。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Censor Jiang Ji and Revenue Commissioner Hu Meng to inspect the army on site; in the end the true figures could not be obtained.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Censor Jiang Ji and Revenue Commissioner Hu Meng to inspect the army on site. In the end the true figures could not be obtained.

sentences.zh: 帝方倚其成功，尋詔兩漕臣措置鎮江酒稅務，助其軍費；

translations.literal: The emperor was then relying on his success; soon an edict ordered the two transport commissioners to arrange Zhenjiang wine-tax offices to assist his military expenses;
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was then relying on his success. Soon an edict ordered the two transport commissioners to arrange Zhenjiang wine-tax offices to assist his military expenses;

sentences.zh: 又罷織禦服羅，省七百萬緡以助之。

translations.literal: weaving of imperial robe silk was also halted, saving seven million strings to assist.
translations.idiomatic: weaving of imperial robe silk was also halted, saving seven million strings to assist.

sentences.zh: 加甯武、甯國軍節度使。

translations.literal: He was added as military governor of the Ningwu and Ningguo armies.
translations.idiomatic: He was added as military governor of the Ningwu and Ningguo armies.

sentences.zh: 光世奏部將喬仲福、靳賽防江有勞，詔進一官，許回授。

translations.literal: Guangshi memorialized that his subordinate generals Qiao Zhongfu and Jin Sai had merit in defending the river; an edict promoted each one rank, with permission to confer on others.
translations.idiomatic: Guangshi memorialized that his subordinate generals Qiao Zhongfu and Jin Sai had merit in defending the river. An edict promoted each one rank, with permission to confer on others.

sentences.zh: 光世固乞轉行，給事中程瑀持不可，又言光世兵未渡江，金人或渡淮，江、浙必震。

translations.literal: Guangshi firmly requested transfer; Supervising Attendant Cheng Yu held it impossible and also said Guangshi's troops had not crossed the river; if the Jurchens crossed the Huai, Jiang and Zhe would surely be shaken.
translations.idiomatic: Guangshi firmly requested transfer. Supervising Attendant Cheng Yu objected and also said Guangshi's troops had not crossed the river; if the Jurchens crossed the Huai, Jiang and Zhe would surely be shaken.

sentences.zh: 光世方遣人按行宜興湖洑之間，以備退保。

translations.literal: Guangshi was then sending men to inspect the area between Yixing and the lake marshes to prepare for withdrawal.
translations.idiomatic: Guangshi was then sending men to inspect the area between Yixing and the lake marshes to prepare for withdrawal.

sentences.zh: 詔以章示之，光世遷延如故。

translations.literal: An edict showed him the memorial; Guangshi delayed as before.
translations.idiomatic: An edict showed him the memorial, but Guangshi delayed as before.

sentences.zh: 三年，命光世與韓世忠易鎮，同召赴闕，授檢校太傅、江東宣撫使。

translations.literal: In the third year Guangshi and Han Shizhong exchanged garrisons and were summoned together to court; he was appointed honorary grand tutor and Jiangdong pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year Guangshi and Han Shizhong exchanged garrisons and were summoned together to court. He was appointed honorary grand tutor and Jiangdong pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 世忠既至鎮江城下，奸人入城焚府庫，光世擒之，皆云世忠所遣。

translations.literal: Once Shizhong reached the foot of Zhenjiang's walls, villains entered the city and burned the treasury; Guangshi captured them, and all said Shizhong had sent them.
translations.idiomatic: Once Shizhong reached the foot of Zhenjiang's walls, villains entered the city and burned the treasury. Guangshi captured them, and all said Shizhong had sent them.

sentences.zh: 世忠屯登雲門，光世引兵出，懼其扼己，改途趨白鷺店。

translations.literal: Shizhong encamped at Dengyun Gate; Guangshi led troops out, fearing he would block him, and changed route toward Bailu Station.
translations.idiomatic: Shizhong encamped at Dengyun Gate. Guangshi led troops out, fearing he would block him, and changed route toward Bailu Station.

sentences.zh: 世忠遣兵襲其後，光世以聞。

translations.literal: Shizhong sent troops to strike his rear; Guangshi reported this.
translations.idiomatic: Shizhong sent troops to strike his rear, and Guangshi reported it.

sentences.zh: 帝遣使和解，仍書《賈復》、《寇恂傳》賜之。

translations.literal: The emperor sent an envoy to reconcile them and still wrote out the Biographies of Jia Fu and Kou Xun to bestow.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor sent an envoy to reconcile them and wrote out the Biographies of Jia Fu and Kou Xun to bestow.

sentences.zh: 命為江東、淮西宣撫使，置司池州，賜錢十萬緡。

translations.literal: He was appointed Jiangdong and Huai West pacification commissioner, established headquarters at Chizhou, and granted a hundred thousand strings.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Jiangdong and Huai West pacification commissioner, established headquarters at Chizhou, and granted a hundred thousand strings.

sentences.zh: 劉豫將王彥先揚兵淮上，有渡江意。

translations.literal: Liu Yu's general Wang Yanxian displayed troops on the Huai with intent to cross the river.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yu's general Wang Yanxian displayed troops on the Huai with intent to cross the river.

sentences.zh: 光世扼馬家渡，遣酈瓊屯無為軍，為濠、廬援，賊乃退。

translations.literal: Guangshi held Majia Ford, sent Li Qiong to encamp at Wuwei Army as support for Hao and Lu, and the bandits withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Guangshi held Majia Ford, sent Li Qiong to encamp at Wuwei Army as support for Hao and Lu, and the bandits withdrew.

sentences.zh: 光世奏鄜延李佾充閣門祗候，言者論其涉私，罷之。

translations.literal: Guangshi memorialized that Li Yi of Yanyan should serve as gatehouse attendant; remonstrators argued this involved private favor and he was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Guangshi memorialized that Li Yi of Yanyan should serve as gatehouse attendant. Remonstrators argued this involved private favor and Yi was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 金人、劉豫入侵，時光世、張俊、韓世忠權相敵，且持私隙，帝遣侍御史魏矼至軍中，諭以滅怨報國。

translations.literal: When the Jurchens and Liu Yu invaded, Guangshi, Zhang Jun, and Han Shizhong were roughly equal in power and held private grudges; the emperor sent Remonstrance Attendant Wei Kang to the armies to urge them to put aside resentment and serve the state.
translations.idiomatic: When the Jurchens and Liu Yu invaded, Guangshi, Zhang Jun, and Han Shizhong were roughly equal in power and held private grudges. The emperor sent Remonstrance Attendant Wei Kang to the armies to urge them to put aside resentment and serve the state.

sentences.zh: 光世乃移書二帥，二帥皆復書致情。

translations.literal: Guangshi then sent letters to the two commanders; both commanders replied with expressions of goodwill.
translations.idiomatic: Guangshi then sent letters to the two commanders, and both replied with expressions of goodwill.

sentences.zh: 光世始移軍太平州以援世忠。

translations.literal: Guangshi then moved his army to Taiping Prefecture to aid Shizhong.
translations.idiomatic: Guangshi then moved his army to Taiping Prefecture to aid Shizhong.

sentences.zh: 金兵退，光世入覲，遷少保。

translations.literal: When the Jurchen troops withdrew, Guangshi had an audience and was promoted to junior guardian.
translations.idiomatic: When the Jurchen troops withdrew, Guangshi had an audience and was promoted to junior guardian.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「卿與世忠以少嫌不釋，然烈士當以氣義相許，先國家而後私仇。」

translations.literal: The emperor said: 'You and Shizhong have not released a small resentment, yet a man of honor should pledge himself by spirit and righteousness, putting the state before private enmity.'
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, 'You and Shizhong have not released a small resentment, yet a man of honor should pledge himself by spirit and righteousness, putting the state before private enmity.'

sentences.zh: 復諭以光武分寇恂、賈復之事。

translations.literal: He again instructed him with how Emperor Guangwu divided Kou Xun and Jia Fu.
translations.idiomatic: He again instructed him with how Emperor Guangwu divided Kou Xun and Jia Fu.

sentences.zh: 光世泣謝，請以所置淮東田易淮西田，給事中晏敦復言其擾民而止；

translations.literal: Guangshi wept and apologized and requested to exchange the Huaidong fields he had established for Huai West fields; Supervising Attendant Yan Dunfu said this would disturb the people and it was stopped;
translations.idiomatic: Guangshi wept and apologized and requested to exchange the Huaidong fields he had established for Huai West fields. Supervising Attendant Yan Dunfu said this would disturb the people and it was stopped;

sentences.zh: 又請並封其三妾為孺人，南渡後，諸大將封妾自此始。

translations.literal: he also requested that all three of his concubines be ennobled as ladies; after the southward crossing, the great generals' ennoblement of concubines began here.
translations.idiomatic: he also requested that all three of his concubines be ennobled as ladies. After the southward crossing, the great generals' ennoblement of concubines began here.

sentences.zh: 會改神武軍為行營護軍，以光世所部稱左護軍。

translations.literal: When the Shenwu Army was changed to the Mobile Camp Guard Army, Guangshi's command was called the Left Guard Army.
translations.idiomatic: When the Shenwu Army was changed to the Mobile Camp Guard Army, Guangshi's command was called the Left Guard Army.

sentences.zh: 劉豫築劉龍城以窺淮西，光世遣王師晟破之，加保靜軍節度使，遂領三鎮。

translations.literal: Liu Yu built Liulong City to spy on Huai West; Guangshi sent Wang Shisheng to break it, was added as military governor of the Baojing Army, and thus held three garrisons.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yu built Liulong City to spy on Huai West. Guangshi sent Wang Shisheng to break it, was added as military governor of the Baojing Army, and thus held three garrisons.

sentences.zh: 張浚撫淮上諸屯，劉豫挾金人分道入侵，命光世屯廬州以招北軍，與韓世忠、張俊鼎立，楊沂中將精卒為後距。

translations.literal: Zhang Jun pacified the garrisons on the Huai; Liu Yu, backed by the Jurchens, invaded by separate routes. Guangshi was ordered to encamp at Luzhou to recruit northern troops, standing with Han Shizhong and Zhang Jun in tripartite array, while Yang Yizhong led picked troops as rear guard.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jun pacified the garrisons on the Huai. Liu Yu, backed by the Jurchens, invaded by separate routes. Guangshi was ordered to encamp at Luzhou to recruit northern troops, standing with Han Shizhong and Zhang Jun in tripartite array, while Yang Yizhong led picked troops as rear guard.

sentences.zh: 劉猊驅鄉民偽為金兵，布淮境。

translations.literal: Liu Ya drove village folk disguised as Jurchen troops and spread them across the Huai region.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Ya drove village folk disguised as Jurchen troops and spread them across the Huai region.

sentences.zh: 光世奏廬難守，密幹趙鼎，欲還太平州。

translations.literal: Guangshi memorialized that Lu was hard to hold, secretly petitioned Zhao Ding, and wished to return to Taiping Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Guangshi memorialized that Lu was hard to hold, secretly petitioned Zhao Ding, and wished to return to Taiping Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 浚命呂祉馳往軍中督師，光世已舍廬州退，浚遣人厲其眾曰：「若有一人渡江，即斬以徇。」

translations.literal: Jun ordered Lü Zhi to ride quickly to the army to supervise the campaign; Guangshi had already abandoned Luzhou and withdrawn. Jun sent men to sternly address his troops: 'If a single man crosses the river, he will be executed as an example.'
translations.idiomatic: Jun ordered Lü Zhi to ride quickly to the army to supervise the campaign. Guangshi had already abandoned Luzhou and withdrawn. Jun sent men to sternly address his troops: 'If a single man crosses the river, he will be executed as an example.'

sentences.zh: 光世不得已，駐兵與沂中相應，遣王德、酈瓊領兵自安豐出謝步，遇金將三戰，皆敗之。

translations.literal: Guangshi had no choice but to encamp in coordination with Yizhong and sent Wang De and Li Qiong to lead troops from Anfeng out through Xiebu; they met a Jurchen general in three battles and defeated him each time.
translations.idiomatic: Guangshi had no choice but to encamp in coordination with Yizhong and sent Wang De and Li Qiong to lead troops from Anfeng out through Xiebu. They met a Jurchen general in three battles and defeated him each time.

sentences.zh: 張浚入對，言光世驕惰不戰，不可為大將，請罷之。

translations.literal: Zhang Jun entered audience and said Guangshi was arrogant, lazy, and would not fight; he could not serve as a great general and requested dismissal.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jun entered audience and said Guangshi was arrogant, lazy, and would not fight. He could not serve as a great general and requested dismissal.

sentences.zh: 帝命與趙鼎議，鼎曰：「光世將家子孫，將卒多出其門，罷之恐拂人心。」

translations.literal: The emperor ordered discussion with Zhao Ding; Ding said: 'Guangshi is a general's descendant; many officers and soldiers come from his household; dismissing him may go against men's hearts.'
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered discussion with Zhao Ding. Ding said, 'Guangshi is a general's descendant; many officers and soldiers come from his household. Dismissing him may go against men's hearts.'

sentences.zh: 遂遷護國、鎮安、保靜軍節度使。

translations.literal: He was thereupon transferred to military governor of the Huguo, Zhen'an, and Baojing armies.
translations.idiomatic: He was thereupon transferred to military governor of the Huguo, Zhen'an, and Baojing armies.

sentences.zh: 右司諫陳公輔劾其不守廬州，張浚言其沈酣酒色，不恤國事，語以恢復，意氣怫然，乞賜罷斥。

translations.literal: Right Secretariat Remonstrance Chen Gongfu impeached him for not holding Luzhou; Zhang Jun said he was sunk in wine and women, cared nothing for state affairs, and when spoken to of recovery grew sullen in spirit, requesting dismissal.
translations.idiomatic: Right Secretariat Remonstrance Chen Gongfu impeached him for not holding Luzhou. Zhang Jun said he was sunk in wine and women, cared nothing for state affairs, and when spoken to of recovery grew sullen in spirit, requesting dismissal.

sentences.zh: 光世引疾請罷軍政，又獻所餘金穀於朝。

translations.literal: Guangshi cited illness and requested dismissal from military affairs, and also presented his remaining gold and grain to the court.
translations.idiomatic: Guangshi cited illness and requested dismissal from military affairs, and also presented his remaining gold and grain to the court.

sentences.zh: 拜少師，充萬壽觀使，奉朝請，封榮國公，賜甲第一區，以兵歸都督府。

translations.literal: He was appointed junior master, director of the Wanshou Abbey, granted attendance at court, enfeoffed as Duke of Rong, granted one mansion, and his troops were returned to the commissionerate.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed junior master, director of the Wanshou Abbey, granted attendance at court, enfeoffed as Duke of Rong, granted one mansion, and his troops were returned to the commissionerate.

sentences.zh: 公輔又言光世雖罷，而遷少師，賞罰不明；

translations.literal: Gongfu again said that though Guangshi was dismissed, he was promoted to junior master—rewards and punishments were unclear;
translations.idiomatic: Gongfu again said that though Guangshi was dismissed, he was promoted to junior master—rewards and punishments were unclear;

sentences.zh: 中書舍人勾龍如淵又繳還賜第之命。

translations.literal: Secretariat Drafter Gou Long Ruyuan also returned the order granting the mansion.
translations.idiomatic: Secretariat Drafter Gou Long Ruyuan also returned the order granting the mansion.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「光世罷兵柄，若恩禮稍加，則諸將知有後福，皆效力矣。」

translations.literal: The emperor said: 'If Guangshi has lost military power yet receives slightly increased favor, the other generals will know there is later fortune and all will exert themselves.'
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, 'If Guangshi has lost military power yet receives slightly increased favor, the other generals will know there is later fortune and all will exert themselves.'

sentences.zh: 卒賜之。

translations.literal: In the end it was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the end it was granted.

sentences.zh: 初，光世麾下多降盜，素無紀律；

translations.literal: Earlier, many of Guangshi's subordinates were surrendered bandits and had never had discipline;
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, many of Guangshi's subordinates were surrendered bandits and had never had discipline;

sentences.zh: 至是，督府命呂祉節制其軍。

translations.literal: now the commissionerate ordered Lü Zhi to command his army.
translations.idiomatic: now the commissionerate ordered Lü Zhi to command his army.

sentences.zh: 酈瓊殺祉，驅諸軍降劉豫。

translations.literal: Li Qiong killed Zhi and drove the armies to surrender to Liu Yu.
translations.idiomatic: Li Qiong killed Zhi and drove the armies to surrender to Liu Yu.

sentences.zh: 九年，用講和恩，賜號「和眾輔國功臣」，進封雍國公、陝西宣撫使。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, through the grace of the peace settlement, he was granted the title "Meritorious Minister Who Harmonizes the Host and Assists the State" and advanced to Duke of Yong and pacification commissioner of Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, through the grace of the peace settlement, he was granted the title "Meritorious Minister Who Harmonizes the Host and Assists the State" and advanced to Duke of Yong and pacification commissioner of Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 弟光遠疏其短於言路，如淵時為中丞，再論光世不可遣而止。

translations.literal: His younger brother Guangyuan memorialized his faults on the remonstrance route; when Goulong Ruyuan was censor-in-chief he twice argued that Guangshi must not be dispatched and stopped it.
translations.idiomatic: His younger brother Guangyuan memorialized his faults on the remonstrance route. When Goulong Ruyuan was censor-in-chief, he twice argued that Guangshi must not be dispatched and stopped it.

sentences.zh: 十年，金人圍順昌，拜太保，為三京招撫處置使，以援劉錡。

translations.literal: In the tenth year the Jurchens besieged Shunchang; he was appointed Grand Guardian and made pacification and disposition commissioner of the Three Capitals to aid Liu Xi.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year the Jurchens besieged Shunchang. He was appointed Grand Guardian and made pacification and disposition commissioner of the Three Capitals to aid Liu Xi.

sentences.zh: 光世請李顯忠為前軍都統，又請王德自隸。

translations.literal: Guangshi requested Li Xianzhong as forward-army overall commander and also asked that Wang De be placed under his own command.
translations.idiomatic: Guangshi requested Li Xianzhong as forward-army overall commander and also asked that Wang De be placed under his own command.

sentences.zh: 德不願受其節制；

translations.literal: De was unwilling to accept his command;
translations.idiomatic: De was unwilling to accept his command;

sentences.zh: 顯忠行至宿、泗，軍多潰。

translations.literal: Xianzhong reached Su and Si, and much of the army collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: Xianzhong reached Su and Si, and much of the army collapsed.

sentences.zh: 進至和州，秦檜主罷兵，召還。

translations.literal: Advancing to He Prefecture, Qin Hui urged halting the campaign and he was recalled.
translations.idiomatic: Advancing to He Prefecture, Qin Hui urged halting the campaign and Guangshi was recalled.

sentences.zh: 光世入見，為萬壽觀使，改封楊國公。

translations.literal: Guangshi had an audience and was made commissioner of the Wanshou View and enfeoffed as Duke of Yang.
translations.idiomatic: Guangshi had an audience and was made commissioner of the Wanshou View and enfeoffed as Duke of Yang.

sentences.zh: 疾革，乞免其家科役，中書舍人張廣格不下。

translations.literal: When his illness became critical he requested exemption from corvée for his household; Secretariat Drafter Zhang Guang withheld approval.
translations.idiomatic: When his illness became critical he requested exemption from corvée for his household. Secretariat Drafter Zhang Guang withheld approval.

sentences.zh: 卒，年五十四。

translations.literal: He died at fifty-four.
translations.idiomatic: He died at fifty-four.

sentences.zh: 贈太師，官其子孫、甥侄十四人，諡「武僖」。

translations.literal: Posthumously he was made Grand Preceptor; fourteen sons, grandsons, and nephews received office, and he was given the posthumous title "Martial and Delightful."
translations.idiomatic: Posthumously he was made Grand Preceptor. Fourteen sons, grandsons, and nephews received office, and he was given the posthumous title "Martial and Delightful."

sentences.zh: 乾道八年，追封安城郡王。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Qiandao he was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Ancheng Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Qiandao he was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Ancheng Commandery.

sentences.zh: 開禧元年，追封鄜王。

translations.literal: In the first year of Kaixi he was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Fu.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Kaixi he was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Fu.

sentences.zh: 光世在諸將中最先進。

translations.literal: Among the generals Guangshi advanced earliest.
translations.idiomatic: Among the generals Guangshi advanced earliest.

sentences.zh: 律身不嚴，馭軍無法，不肯為國任事，逋寇自資，見詆公論。

translations.literal: He did not discipline himself strictly, had no method of controlling troops, refused to undertake state business, enriched himself by letting bandits escape, and was reviled in public opinion.
translations.idiomatic: He did not discipline himself strictly, had no method of controlling troops, refused to undertake state business, enriched himself by letting bandits escape, and was reviled in public opinion.

sentences.zh: 嘗入對，言：「願竭力報國，他日史官書臣功第一。」

translations.literal: Once in audience he said: 'I wish to exert all my strength for the state; someday the historiographers will record my merit as first.'
translations.idiomatic: Once in audience he said, 'I wish to exert all my strength for the state. Someday the historiographers will record my merit as first.'

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「卿不可徒為空言，當見之行事。」

translations.literal: The emperor said: 'You must not speak empty words; it should be seen in action.'
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, 'You must not speak empty words. It should be seen in action.'

sentences.zh: 建炎初，結內侍康履以自固。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Jianyan he bonded with the eunuch Kang Lü to secure himself.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Jianyan he bonded with the eunuch Kang Lü to secure himself.

sentences.zh: 又蚤解兵柄，與時浮沉，不為秦檜所忌，故能竊寵榮以終其身，方之韓、岳遠矣。

translations.literal: He also relinquished military power early, floated with the times, and was not resented by Qin Hui; therefore he was able to steal favor and glory to the end of his life—far indeed from Han and Yue.
translations.idiomatic: He also relinquished military power early, floated with the times, and was not resented by Qin Hui. Therefore he was able to steal favor and glory to the end of his life—far indeed from Han and Yue.

sentences.zh: 王淵，字幾道，熙州人，後徙環州。

translations.literal: Wang Yuan, styled Jidao, was a native of Xizhou and later moved to Huanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yuan, styled Jidao, came from Xizhou and later moved to Huanzhou.

sentences.zh: 善騎射。

translations.literal: He was skilled at riding and archery.
translations.idiomatic: He was skilled at riding and archery.

sentences.zh: 應募擊夏國，屢有功，累遷熙河蘭湟路第三將部將、權知鞏州寧遠砦。

translations.literal: He volunteered to strike the Xia state and repeatedly achieved merit; by accumulated promotion he rose to company commander of the third command of the Xihe-Lan-Huang Circuit and acting prefect of Ningyuan Stockade in Gong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He volunteered to strike the Xia state and repeatedly achieved merit. By accumulated promotion he rose to company commander of the third command of the Xihe-Lan-Huang Circuit and acting prefect of Ningyuan Stockade in Gong Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 諸羌入寇，經略司討之，表淵總領岷山蕃兵將，興師城澤州。

translations.literal: When the Qiang tribes invaded, the pacification commission suppressed them and memorialized that Yuan should overall command the Minshan tribal troops and raise an army to fortify Ze Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: When the Qiang tribes invaded, the pacification commission suppressed them and memorialized that Yuan should overall command the Minshan tribal troops and raise an army to fortify Ze Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 羌悉眾來爭，淵奮擊，大破之，追至邈川城。

translations.literal: The Qiang gathered all their strength to contest it; Yuan fought fiercely and inflicted a great defeat, pursuing to Miaochuan city.
translations.idiomatic: The Qiang gathered all their strength to contest it. Yuan fought fiercely and inflicted a great defeat, pursuing to Miaochuan city.

sentences.zh: 移同總領湟州蕃兵將兼知臨宗砦，坐法免。

translations.literal: He was transferred to concurrently overall command the Huangzhou tribal troops and concurrently prefect of Linzong Stockade; through violation of law he was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to concurrently overall command the Huangzhou tribal troops and concurrently prefect of Linzong Stockade. Through violation of law he was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 宣和三年，劉延慶討方臘，以淵為先鋒。

translations.literal: In the third year of Xuanhe Liu Yanqing suppressed Fang La and made Yuan vanguard.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Xuanhe Liu Yanqing suppressed Fang La and made Yuan vanguard.

sentences.zh: 賊將據錢塘，勢張甚。

translations.literal: The bandit general held Qiantang and his momentum was very strong.
translations.idiomatic: The bandit general held Qiantang and his momentum was very strong.

sentences.zh: 淵諭小校韓世忠曰：「賊謂我遠來，必易我。

translations.literal: Yuan told the junior officer Han Shizhong: 'The bandits think we have come from far away and will surely underestimate us.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan told the junior officer Han Shizhong, 'The bandits think we have come from far away and will surely underestimate us.

sentences.zh: 明日爾逆戰而偽遁，我以強弩伏數百步外，必可得志。」

translations.literal: Tomorrow you fight them head-on and feign retreat; I will set strong crossbows in ambush several hundred paces away and we will surely succeed.'
translations.idiomatic: Tomorrow you fight them head-on and feign retreat. I will set strong crossbows in ambush several hundred paces away and we will surely succeed.'

sentences.zh: 世忠如其言，賊果追之，伏弩卒發，應弦而倒。

translations.literal: Shizhong did as he said; the bandits indeed pursued, the ambush crossbows suddenly released, and they fell at the bowstring's release.
translations.idiomatic: Shizhong did as he said. The bandits indeed pursued, the ambush crossbows suddenly released, and they fell at the bowstring's release.

sentences.zh: 逐北至淳安，賊據幫源峒，遂圍而平之。

translations.literal: Pursuing north to Chun'an, the bandits held Bangyuan Cave; he besieged and pacified it.
translations.idiomatic: Pursuing north to Chun'an, the bandits held Bangyuan Cave. He besieged and pacified it.

sentences.zh: 授閣門宣贊舍人、權京畿提舉保甲兼權提點刑獄公事。

translations.literal: He was appointed Gatehouse Proclamation Attendant, acting Metropolitan Circuit promoter of the baojia system and acting circuit intendant of penal affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Gatehouse Proclamation Attendant, acting Metropolitan Circuit promoter of the baojia system and acting circuit intendant of penal affairs.

sentences.zh: 繼從延慶攻契丹。

translations.literal: Later he served under Yanqing in attacking the Khitan.
translations.idiomatic: Later he served under Yanqing in attacking the Khitan.

sentences.zh: 重兵壁盧溝南，遣淵等數千人護餉道，戰敗為敵所獲。

translations.literal: Heavy troops walled south of the Lugou; Yuan and several thousand others were sent to guard the supply route, were defeated in battle, and were captured by the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: Heavy troops walled south of the Lugou. Yuan and several thousand others were sent to guard the supply route, were defeated in battle, and were captured by the enemy.

sentences.zh: 已而逃歸，猶以出塞遷武功大夫、果州團練使。

translations.literal: Later he escaped and returned, yet for crossing the frontier was transferred to Wugong Dafu and regimental commissioner of Guo Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Later he escaped and returned, yet for crossing the frontier was transferred to Grandee of Martial Achievement and regimental commissioner of Guo Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 又從楊惟忠、辛興宗破群盜高托山等，遷拱衛大夫、甯州觀察使。

translations.literal: He again followed Yang Weizhong and Xin Xingzong in breaking the bandits Gao Tuoshan and others and was transferred to Gongwei Dafu and observation commissioner of Ning Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He again followed Yang Weizhong and Xin Xingzong in breaking the bandits Gao Tuoshan and others and was transferred to Grandee of the Palace Guard and observation commissioner of Ning Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 靖康元年，為真定府總管，就遷都統制。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jingkang he was overall commander of Zhending Prefecture and concurrently promoted to overall commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Jingkang he was overall commander of Zhending Prefecture and concurrently promoted to overall commander.

sentences.zh: 吳湛據趙州叛，淵討平之。

translations.literal: Wu Zhan rebelled and held Zhao Prefecture; Yuan suppressed and pacified him.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Zhan rebelled and held Zhao Prefecture. Yuan suppressed and pacified him.

sentences.zh: 金人攻汴京，河東、北宣撫使范訥統勤王兵屯雍丘，以淵為先鋒。

translations.literal: When the Jurchens attacked Bianjing, Hedong-North Pacification Commissioner Fan Ne overall commanded the troops rushing to the emperor's aid encamped at Yongqiu and made Yuan vanguard.
translations.idiomatic: When the Jurchens attacked Bianjing, Hedong-North Pacification Commissioner Fan Ne overall commanded the troops rushing to the emperor's aid encamped at Yongqiu and made Yuan vanguard.

sentences.zh: 尋以所部歸康王府。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he brought his command to the Prince of Kang's household.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he brought his command to the Prince of Kang's household.

sentences.zh: 明年，張邦昌僭立，康王如濟州，命淵以三千人入衛宗廟。

translations.literal: The next year Zhang Bangchang usurped the throne; the Prince of Kang went to Jizhou and ordered Yuan with three thousand men to enter and guard the imperial ancestral temple.
translations.idiomatic: The next year Zhang Bangchang usurped the throne. The Prince of Kang went to Jizhou and ordered Yuan with three thousand men to enter and guard the imperial ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 淵至汴都，以朝服見邦昌，納謁曰：「參塚宰相公。」

translations.literal: Yuan reached the Bian capital, saw Bangchang in court dress, and paid respects saying: 'Greetings to the Prime Minister of the Ancestral Tombs.'
translations.idiomatic: Yuan reached the Bian capital, saw Bangchang in court dress, and paid respects saying, 'Greetings to the Prime Minister of the Ancestral Tombs.'

sentences.zh: 邦昌始易紫袍延之政事堂，淵慟哭宣教。

translations.literal: Bangchang then changed to purple robes and received him in the Hall of Administration; Yuan wept and proclaimed the edict.
translations.idiomatic: Bangchang then changed to purple robes and received him in the Hall of Administration. Yuan wept and proclaimed the edict.

sentences.zh: 康王即皇帝位，淵與楊惟忠、韓世忠以河北兵，劉光世以陝西兵，張俊、苗傅等以帥府及降群盜兵，皆在行朝，不相統一。

translations.literal: When the Prince of Kang ascended the throne, Yuan with Yang Weizhong and Han Shizhong brought Hebei troops, Liu Guangshi brought Shaanxi troops, and Zhang Jun, Miao Fu, and others brought marshal's household and surrendered bandit troops—all were at the mobile court and not unified in command.
translations.idiomatic: When the Prince of Kang ascended the throne, Yuan with Yang Weizhong and Han Shizhong brought Hebei troops, Liu Guangshi brought Shaanxi troops, and Zhang Jun, Miao Fu, and others brought marshal's household and surrendered bandit troops—all were at the mobile court and not unified in command.

sentences.zh: 始置禦營司，以淵為都統制，扈從累月不釋甲。

translations.literal: The Imperial Camp Commission was first established and Yuan was made overall commander; he escorted the emperor for months without removing armor.
translations.idiomatic: The Imperial Camp Commission was first established and Yuan was made overall commander. He escorted the emperor for months without removing armor.

sentences.zh: 帝如揚州，授龍、神衛四廂都指揮使，尋改捧日、天武四廂都指揮使，進保大軍承宣使。

translations.literal: When the emperor went to Yangzhou, he was appointed overall commander of the four divisions of the Dragon and Divine Guard Armies, soon changed to the four divisions of the Puri and Tianwu Armies, and promoted to commissioner-in-chief of the Baoda Army.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor went to Yangzhou, he was appointed overall commander of the four divisions of the Dragon and Divine Guard Armies, soon changed to the four divisions of the Puri and Tianwu Armies, and promoted to commissioner-in-chief of the Baoda Army.

sentences.zh: 時群盜蜂起，以淵為制置使平杭賊，提兵四出，所向皆捷。

translations.literal: At that time bandits swarmed; Yuan was made pacification commissioner to pacify Hangzhou bandits, led troops in four directions, and wherever he went was victorious.
translations.idiomatic: At that time bandits swarmed. Yuan was made pacification commissioner to pacify Hangzhou bandits, led troops in four directions, and wherever he went was victorious.

sentences.zh: 平軍賊趙萬於鎮江，誅杭賊陳通於杭州，降張遇于楊子橋；

translations.literal: He pacified the bandit Zhao Wan at Zhenjiang, executed the Hangzhou bandit Chen Tong at Hangzhou, and accepted Zhang Yu's surrender at Yangzi Bridge;
translations.idiomatic: He pacified the bandit Zhao Wan at Zhenjiang, executed the Hangzhou bandit Chen Tong at Hangzhou, and accepted Zhang Yu's surrender at Yangzi Bridge;

sentences.zh: 期年，群盜略盡。

translations.literal: within a year bandits were nearly all gone.
translations.idiomatic: within a year bandits were nearly all gone.

sentences.zh: 遷嚮德軍節度使。

translations.literal: He was transferred to military governor of the Xiangde Army.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to military governor of the Xiangde Army.

sentences.zh: 惟趙萬、陳通等已招其降，而復盡誅之。

translations.literal: Yet Zhao Wan, Chen Tong, and others had already been recruited to surrender and were then entirely executed.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Zhao Wan, Chen Tong, and others had already been recruited to surrender and were then entirely executed.

sentences.zh: 建炎三年二月，金人攻揚州，帝倉卒渡江，淵與內侍康履從至鎮江。

translations.literal: In the second month of the third year of Jianyan the Jurchens attacked Yangzhou; the emperor hastily crossed the river, and Yuan with the eunuch Kang Lü followed to Zhenjiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the third year of Jianyan the Jurchens attacked Yangzhou. The emperor hastily crossed the river, and Yuan with the eunuch Kang Lü followed to Zhenjiang.

sentences.zh: 奉國軍節度使劉光世見帝泣告：「淵專管江上海船，每言緩急決不誤事。

translations.literal: Fengguo Army military governor Liu Guangshi saw the emperor and wept, reporting: 'Yuan alone manages the river and sea boats on the Jiang and always says that in urgency he will not fail.
translations.idiomatic: Fengguo Army military governor Liu Guangshi saw the emperor and wept, reporting, 'Yuan alone manages the river and sea boats on the Jiang and always says that in urgency he will not fail.

sentences.zh: 今臣所部數萬，二千餘騎，皆不能濟。」

translations.literal: Now my command of several tens of thousands, more than two thousand horsemen, all cannot cross.'
translations.idiomatic: Now my command of several tens of thousands, more than two thousand horsemen, all cannot cross.'

sentences.zh: 淵忿其言，斬江北都巡檢皇甫佐以自解。

translations.literal: Yuan resented his words and executed North-of-the-River Chief Inspector Huangfu Zuo to explain himself.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan resented his words and executed North-of-the-River Chief Inspector Huangfu Zuo to explain himself.

sentences.zh: 中書侍郎朱勝非馳見淵督之，乃始經畫，已無所及，自是淵失諸將心。

translations.literal: Chief Minister Zhu Shengfei rode quickly to see Yuan and urge him; only then did he begin planning, but it was already too late. From this Yuan lost the generals' hearts.
translations.idiomatic: Chief Minister Zhu Shengfei rode quickly to see Yuan and urge him. Only then did he begin planning, but it was already too late. From this Yuan lost the generals' hearts.

sentences.zh: 帝欲如鎮江以援江北，群臣亦固請。

translations.literal: The emperor wished to go to Zhenjiang to aid the north of the river; the ministers also firmly requested it.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor wished to go to Zhenjiang to aid the north of the river; the ministers also firmly requested it.

sentences.zh: 淵獨言：「鎮江止可捍一面，若金人自通州渡，先據姑蘇，將若之何？

translations.literal: Yuan alone said: 'Zhenjiang can only defend one face; if the Jurchens cross from Tong Prefecture and first seize Gusu, what then?
translations.idiomatic: Yuan alone said, 'Zhenjiang can only defend one face. If the Jurchens cross from Tong Prefecture and first seize Gusu, what then?

sentences.zh: 不如錢塘有重江之險。」

translations.literal: Qiantang has the barrier of a heavy river.'
translations.idiomatic: Qiantang has the barrier of a heavy river.'

sentences.zh: 議遂決。

translations.literal: The decision was settled.
translations.idiomatic: The decision was settled.

sentences.zh: 命淵守姑蘇，言戎器全缺，兵匠甚少，乞括民匠營繕。

translations.literal: Yuan was ordered to hold Gusu; he said weapons of war were entirely lacking and military craftsmen very few, and requested impressing civilian craftsmen for repair.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan was ordered to hold Gusu. He said weapons of war were entirely lacking and military craftsmen very few, and requested impressing civilian craftsmen for repair.

sentences.zh: 尋自平江赴行在，拜簽書樞密院事，仍兼都統制。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he came from Pingjiang to the mobile court, was appointed signed commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, and still concurrently overall commander.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he came from Pingjiang to the mobile court, was appointed signed commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, and still concurrently overall commander.

sentences.zh: 命下，諸將籍籍。

translations.literal: When the order was issued the generals murmured.
translations.idiomatic: When the order was issued the generals murmured.

sentences.zh: 帝聞之，乃命免奏事簽書，仍解都統制，以慰眾心。

translations.literal: The emperor heard of it and ordered that he be exempted from memorializing as signed commissioner and still be relieved of overall command to reassure the people's hearts.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor heard of it and ordered that he be exempted from memorializing as signed commissioner and still be relieved of overall command to reassure the people's hearts.

sentences.zh: 先是，統制官苗傅自負世將，以淵驟用，頗觖望；

translations.literal: Earlier, overall controller Miao Fu, proud of being from a military family, resented Yuan's sudden promotion;
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, overall controller Miao Fu, proud of being from a military family, resented Yuan's sudden promotion;

sentences.zh: 劉正彥嘗招巨盜丁進，亦以賞薄怨淵。

translations.literal: Liu Zhengyan had once recruited the great bandit Ding Jin and also resented Yuan for meager rewards.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Zhengyan had once recruited the great bandit Ding Jin and also resented Yuan for meager rewards.

sentences.zh: 而內侍康履頗用事，及淵入樞府，傅、正彥以其由宦官薦，愈不平。

translations.literal: The eunuch Kang Lü wielded considerable power; when Yuan entered the Bureau of Military Affairs, Fu and Zhengyan resented all the more that he had been recommended by a eunuch.
translations.idiomatic: The eunuch Kang Lü wielded considerable power. When Yuan entered the Bureau of Military Affairs, Fu and Zhengyan resented all the more that he had been recommended by a eunuch.

sentences.zh: 俟淵入朝，伏兵殺之，並殺康履，遂成明受之變。

translations.literal: They waited until Yuan entered court, set troops in ambush, killed him, and also killed Kang Lü, thus bringing about the Mingzhou mutiny.
translations.idiomatic: They waited until Yuan entered court, set troops in ambush, killed him, and also killed Kang Lü, thus bringing about the Mingzhou mutiny.

sentences.zh: 淵時年五十三。

translations.literal: Yuan was then fifty-three.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan was then fifty-three.

sentences.zh: 淵為將輕財好義，家無宿儲，每言：「朝廷官人以爵祿足代耕，若事錐刀，我何愛爵祿，曷若為富商大賈邪？」

translations.literal: As a general Yuan was generous with wealth and fond of righteousness; his household had no stored provisions. He often said: 'The court appoints men with rank and salary sufficient to replace farming; if one haggles over pennies, why should I cherish rank and salary—why not become a great merchant?'
translations.idiomatic: As a general Yuan was generous with wealth and fond of righteousness; his household had no stored provisions. He often said, 'The court appoints men with rank and salary sufficient to replace farming. If one haggles over pennies, why should I cherish rank and salary—why not become a great merchant?'

sentences.zh: 初，帝在南京，聞淵疾，遣中使曾澤問疾。

translations.literal: At first, when the emperor was at Nanjing, he heard Yuan was ill and sent Palace Envoy Zeng Ze to inquire after his illness.
translations.idiomatic: At first, when the emperor was at Nanjing, he heard Yuan was ill and sent Palace Envoy Zeng Ze to inquire after his illness.

sentences.zh: 澤還，言其帷幔茵褥皆不具，帝輟所禦紫茸茵以賜。

translations.literal: When Ze returned he said Yuan's curtains, mattresses, and bedding were all lacking; the emperor set aside his own purple fleece mat to grant him.
translations.idiomatic: When Ze returned he said Yuan's curtains, mattresses, and bedding were all lacking. The emperor set aside his own purple fleece mat to grant him.

sentences.zh: 然其平群盜多殺降，與康履深交，故及於禍。

translations.literal: Yet in pacifying bandits he often killed those who had surrendered, and he was deeply intimate with Kang Lü; therefore he met with disaster.
translations.idiomatic: Yet in pacifying bandits he often killed those who had surrendered, and he was deeply intimate with Kang Lü; therefore he met with disaster.

sentences.zh: 贈開府儀同三司，累加少保，官其子孫八人。

translations.literal: Posthumously he was made Commissioner with the Same Rank as the Three Excellencies, cumulatively promoted to junior guardian, and eight of his sons and grandsons were given office.
translations.idiomatic: Posthumously he was made Commissioner with the Same Rank as the Three Excellencies, cumulatively promoted to junior guardian, and eight of his sons and grandsons were given office.

sentences.zh: 紹興四年，又官二人。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Shaoxing two more were given office.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Shaoxing two more were given office.

sentences.zh: 乾道六年，諡襄湣。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Qiandao his posthumous title was Xiangmin.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Qiandao his posthumous title was Xiangmin.

sentences.zh: 子倚。

translations.literal: His son was Yi.
translations.idiomatic: His son was Yi.

sentences.zh: 解元，字善長，保安軍德清砦人。

translations.literal: Jie Yuan, styled Shanchang, was a native of Deqing Stockade in Bao'an Army.
translations.idiomatic: Jie Yuan, styled Shanchang, came from Deqing Stockade in Bao'an Army.

sentences.zh: 疏眉俊目，猿臂，善騎射。

translations.literal: He had sparse brows and handsome eyes, ape-like arms, and was skilled at riding and archery.
translations.idiomatic: He had sparse brows and handsome eyes, ape-like arms, and was skilled at riding and archery.

sentences.zh: 起行伍，為清澗都虞候。

translations.literal: He rose from the ranks and was chief adjutant of Qingjian.
translations.idiomatic: He rose from the ranks and was chief adjutant of Qingjian.

sentences.zh: 建炎三年，隸大將韓世忠麾下，擢偏將。

translations.literal: In the third year of Jianyan he came under the great general Han Shizhong and was promoted to deputy general.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Jianyan he came under the great general Han Shizhong and was promoted to deputy general.

sentences.zh: 世忠出下邳，聞金兵大至，士皆駭愕。

translations.literal: When Shizhong went out from Xiapi and heard that Jurchen troops had arrived in force, the soldiers were all alarmed.
translations.idiomatic: When Shizhong went out from Xiapi and heard that Jurchen troops had arrived in force, the soldiers were all alarmed.

sentences.zh: 元領二十騎擒其生口，知敵動息。

translations.literal: Yuan led twenty horsemen to capture prisoners and learned the enemy's movements.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan led twenty horsemen to capture prisoners and learned the enemy's movements.

sentences.zh: 俄逢騎數百，身自陷陣，橫刺酋長墜馬，餘皆遁去。

translations.literal: Soon he met several hundred horsemen, personally plunged into the formation, struck the chieftain horizontally and knocked him from his horse, and the rest all fled.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he met several hundred horsemen, personally plunged into the formation, struck the chieftain horizontally and knocked him from his horse, and the rest all fled.

sentences.zh: 授閤門宣贊舍人。

translations.literal: He was appointed Gatehouse Proclamation Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Gatehouse Proclamation Attendant.

sentences.zh: 苗傅、劉正彥之變，從世忠追至臨平與戰，賊勢既衰，擒於浦城。

translations.literal: In the Miao Fu and Liu Zhengyan mutiny he followed Shizhong in pursuit to Linping and fought; once the rebels' momentum had waned, they were captured at Pucheng.
translations.idiomatic: In the Miao Fu and Liu Zhengyan mutiny he followed Shizhong in pursuit to Linping and fought. Once the rebels' momentum had waned, they were captured at Pucheng.

sentences.zh: 四年三月，金人攻浙西，世忠治兵京口，邀其歸路，以海艦橫截大江。

translations.literal: In the third month of the fourth year the Jurchens attacked western Zhejiang; Shizhong trained troops at Jingkou and blocked their return route, using sea ships to bar the great river.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the fourth year the Jurchens attacked western Zhejiang. Shizhong trained troops at Jingkou and blocked their return route, using sea ships to bar the great river.

sentences.zh: 金人出小舟數十，以長鉤扳艦。

translations.literal: The Jurchens sent out several tens of small boats and used long hooks to pull at the ships.
translations.idiomatic: The Jurchens sent out several tens of small boats and used long hooks to pull at the ships.

sentences.zh: 元在別舸躍入敵舟，以短兵擊殺數十人，擒其千戶。

translations.literal: Yuan was on a separate boat, leaped into an enemy vessel, killed several tens of men with short weapons, and captured their chiliarch.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan was on a separate boat, leaped into an enemy vessel, killed several tens of men with short weapons, and captured their chiliarch.

sentences.zh: 授忠州團練使，統制前軍。

translations.literal: He was appointed regimental commissioner of Zhong Prefecture and overall controller of the vanguard.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed regimental commissioner of Zhong Prefecture and overall controller of the vanguard.

sentences.zh: 繼從討閩寇範汝為，轉討湖外諸盜。

translations.literal: Later he followed in suppressing the Fujian bandit Fan Ruwei and turned to suppressing bandits outside the lakes.
translations.idiomatic: Later he followed in suppressing the Fujian bandit Fan Ruwei and turned to suppressing bandits outside the lakes.

sentences.zh: 時劉忠據白麵山，憑險築壘。

translations.literal: At that time Liu Zhong held Baimian Mountain and relied on the terrain to build fortifications.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Liu Zhong held Baimian Mountain and relied on the terrain to build fortifications.

sentences.zh: 世忠討之，距賊營三十里而陣。

translations.literal: Shizhong suppressed him and formed battle lines thirty li from the bandit camp.
translations.idiomatic: Shizhong suppressed him and formed battle lines thirty li from the bandit camp.

sentences.zh: 元獨跨馬涉水薄賊砦，四顧周覽。

translations.literal: Yuan alone crossed his horse through the water and pressed close to the bandit stockade, looking all around.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan alone crossed his horse through the water and pressed close to the bandit stockade, looking all around.

sentences.zh: 賊因山設望樓，從高瞰下，以兵守之，屯壯銳於四山，視其指呼而出戰。

translations.literal: The bandits set watch towers on the mountain, looked down from the heights, guarded them with troops, and stationed picked troops on the four mountains, sending them out to fight according to signals.
translations.idiomatic: The bandits set watch towers on the mountain, looked down from the heights, guarded them with troops, and stationed picked troops on the four mountains, sending them out to fight according to signals.

sentences.zh: 元既得其形勢，歸告世忠曰：「易與爾，若奪據其望樓，則技窮矣。」

translations.literal: Once Yuan had grasped their disposition, he returned and told Shizhong: 'They are easy to deal with; if we seize their watch towers, their stratagems will be exhausted.'
translations.idiomatic: Once Yuan had grasped their disposition, he returned and told Shizhong, 'They are easy to deal with. If we seize their watch towers, their stratagems will be exhausted.'
